notes.player: Lord Felputh’s faithful bodyguard, assigned to accompany the party and ‘help’ them. In truth, her mission is to ensure they perish if they learn too much. The noble has made it clear that if he goes down, Sandik goes down with him. She’s a survivor and native of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth} who learned that ‘morals’ are a weakness long ago. She’ll betray Lord Felputh willingly, if she can do so without tainting her reputation. She hopes to find another, richer noble to employ her after this mess is over.

Morgan Trace, like her childhood friend Adriana Corbid, is a former member of a noble house of Hive Dalal. Unlike Corbid, though, she left @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-dalal]{Hive Dalal} willingly and freely, chafing under her family's strict rule and the thumb of House Nethecaré. It was her example that convinced Corbid to follow her to region Gamma-74 a few years later when her family forbade her from seeing Sihn. 

Corbid did not realise that while Trace had left the hive, she had never left her family. She still serves her house, funnelling money and information to it in exchange for being allowed to play pirate in the wasteland. She attacks assets for them to weaken the house’s rivals, and in return, they send her money, troops, or equipment, whatever she needs to keep her operation going.

Zenyi Restax is a woman of few words. She has a job to do, and she just wants to get it done. The party meets her when Rastigan Dorin, her Patron, assigns her to drive them around the wasteland in her Cargo-8. She is loyal to Dorin, who pays well and generally keeps her out of trouble, and she transports whomever or whatever is asked of her, no questions asked. 

She absolutely refuses to discuss Markis Sihn or the Eye, saying she doesn’t believe in all that nonsense. This is primarily true, but not the entire truth. She has driven Sihn around several times for Dorin. Her Patron’s orders are clear: transport the offworlders, inform him where they are going, and tell the party as little as possible.

Among the Vertexis’s initiates, one wayward citizen went so far as to discard their name and identity to become a living effigy of Eversor Interitas, being the cult’s guiding and more relatable leadership in the Assassin’s stead. In the dark, the man’s fervour was stoked by a hidden heretek, who saw in him the potential to lead the cult in Interitas’s stead, granting the Harbinger his iconic Power Scythe, and promising more if their plans around Halion’s Triumph were successful.

Acynadi Beta-3 are among the larger farmable strains and are about half the size of an average canid. Despite their stature and verminous nature, they shouldn’t be underestimated — they pack just as much of a bite, and seem to eat just about anything, including Human flesh.

Acynadi Gamma-7 are a rare and large variant. It is about as long as a Sentinel is tall, and standing upright, it appears about the same size as an Ogryn. It is a spindly creature, just as capable of burrowing into tight spaces and climbing as smaller strains.

Ogryn are a rare sight on Voll, and the Infractionists among them are highly sought allies for @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Rokarth}’s gangs as powerful force multipliers and deterrents. Many gangs dote on their abhuman allies, to keep them sweet and loyal to the gang. Smart gang leaders know that if the Ogryn ever figured out how to band together and build a gang of their own, they’d become a force to be reckoned with, and likely be running the Lower Hive in a matter of months.

This minor noble, of indeterminate age, may not always have been the shaky, nervous, skeletal creature he is today. Lord Arthos Felputh clearly takes pains to rejuvenate his appearance, with smooth skin stretched over his shaven skull and a complete set of golden teeth flashing from behind his rebreather. He wears this whenever meeting anyone from outside his household, ensuring protection from toxins in the air, along with a full bodysuit exquisitely decorated by House Parnham in the magenta of his crest, to save him from an assassin’s blade or pistol. He has no living relatives since doing so might put his life at risk.

Desperate citizens, especially those stamped underfoot by a hive city’s labyrinthine hierarchies, are often ripe for indoctrination into any manner of cult that promises their lives direction, meaning and service to the God-Emperor in some shape or form. The Vertexis formed around the rapidly spreading hive myths and legends surrounding Eversor Interitas and his holy mission to purge @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Rokarth} of unworthy and sinful citizens. They pledged their aid to the Assassin’s mission, even if they did not understand its truth.

Adriana Corbid, the Left Hand of Sihn, is Markis Sihn’s lover and companion. Formerly an heir to House Corbid of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-dalal]{Hive Dalal}, like many other highborn, she recognised that @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.AgChFLsZYrdMa2pS#nethecare]{House Nethecaré} had been squeezing the other noble houses out of the hive and sought refuge elsewhere. It wasn’t long after that she first encountered Sihn. He was the antithesis of everything her family stood for, and she became loyal to him, sharing his vision of what the planetary region could become. Her constant proximity to Markis Sihn has led to her also being affected by the entity that is stoking his powers. It has caused her to have visions and dreams of Sihn ruling over all of Voll as an Imperial saint. 

Corbid is not a competent fighter, but she stole several expensive items from House Corbid when she left, which keeps her lethal in the eyes of the cult. She does not trust the so-called Right Hand of Sihn. Under his mask, she knows the man is someone important in the region, but she craves Sihn’s attention for herself and doesn’t want the Right Hand meddling in the cult’s affairs. The Right Hand was the one who called for the disastrous attack on the crawler. Though it led to the capture of the Eye of Voll, she knows it has garnered scrutiny and drawn outsiders to the region.

notes.gm:
‘A sharply featured woman, gaunt and tall with loosely fixed auburn hair prematurely greying at her temples. Her bookish appearance is heavily contrasted by her polished augmetic hand.’

Taxia Varness serves as Curator and second in command aboard the Interminable Devotion. She presides diligently over her scribes from the @UUID[JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.vC2n6yi7x19C9HvR#a2.-central-cogitarum]{Central Cogitarum} buried in the craft’s guts, overseeing all data transmitted to her superior, Captain Veridian. 

Unbeknownst to her often fearful underlings, Varness ensures that the data is scrubbed clear of any irregular reports or inexplicable pictures before submission to the Captain. @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#medicae-roderick]{Medicae Roderick}’s tales of Inquisitorial interrogations have done much to stoke her fears of what might happen to those who possess evidence of unexplainable phenomena. As a result, much of her taciturn demeanour is a mask to hide an existence of perpetual anxiety. 

If asked about her hand, she truthfully explains she lost it in an airlock malfunction some years ago and comments on @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#medicae-roderick]{Medicae Roderick}’s remarkable craftsmanship. Unbeknownst to her Roderick has planted a small listening device in her augmetic.

Curator Varness uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.wzB86nJHHIRHMQTO]{Overseer} stat-block.

notes.player: Talgore is the Beastmen Shaman, an influential spiritual leader and minor psyker, who commands the loyalty of most of the Beastmen. He organised the uprising amongst the refinery’s Beastmen, imprisoning their former leader, Mesk, and is now exploring the bounds of his powers in the tunnels below the refinery. He’s infusing kidnapped workers with the ‘gifts’ of his dark gods, turning some into mutants but sacrificing most in their name.

‘Stand aside, Citizen.'

Macharian Vigilites answer directly to the decrees of Planetary Governor Jaspar @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#castyx]{Castyx}, to ensure their own position and fulfil their tithes. They maintain law and order as it serves the Governor’s purposes. They wear heavy armour and weaponry designed to function as an open threat. Where Enforcers encounter opposition they are brutal in administering ‘justice’. Enforcers turn a blind eye to infractions for the right price.

Escar Heldrax grew up in a hive city. He escaped being tithed to the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.r6JYS3jOfrAEorvd]{Astra Militarum} by joining the ranks of a petty gang; he learned how to be efficient and push himself to do what others would refuse to do. He rose through the ranks of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#criminal-cartels]{Jau Clan} before being recruited by Ekaterina. Heldrax prefers stealth and persuasion before turning to violence but is more than happy to get dirty if needed. His demeanour is always calm, and he is always calculating his next move.

Trigarian Caul goes only by Caul. He claims to be a voice of the God-Emperor, capable of hearing guidance from the holy seat of Terra. A sanctioned psyker with mighty divination powers, Caul was plucked from obscurity by an Arch-Confessor, who recognised the power of Caul’s precognition and shielded him from Ministorum repercussions (as long as he does precisely what the Arch-Confessor deems). A fervent believer in the Imperial Creed, Caul uses what he believes is God-Emperor granted holy precognition powers to safely guide him and his team to their objective. When that fails, he falls back on the purifying flames of the Sanctifier’s flamers. Clad in holy vestments, hunched, with a cowl that masks most of his face, Caul has candles and incense burners mounted to his back, purifying him and his team with holy incense and the holy light of Terra.

Gelka may have disapproved of Mesk’s meekness as a leader, but Talgore’s corruption and the herd’s weak wills make her furious. She intends to destroy the Shaman and has been hiding in the tunnels, biding her time, waiting for the opportunity to get him on his own. She hopes to liberate those among the herd who haven’t succumbed to Chaos and assume leadership herself. She dreams of liberating them from the refinery and away from @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Rokarth}. She doesn’t think much of Humans, so while she’ll work with the characters when it suits her, she’ll also willingly betray and kill them if it furthers her aims.

A capable assassin and woman of few words, Trissa Vant is Heldrax’s right hand. An extremely capable sharpshooter, Vant is not often at Heldrax’s side but instead hidden under her cameleoline cloak, covering Heldrax through her rifle’s sights. If she is seen in person, she is quiet and wound up, like a snake ready to strike. She trusts no one other than Heldrax and seeks to kill anyone who gets in his way unless he has ordered her not to.

notes.gm:
Tybaris Arx is an apprentice Biologis who is steadily working through the ranks of Forge Fane Incalcos-6 under many of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Rokarth's} greatest Tech-adept minds. He acknowledged that his latest duty, deployment to Manufactorum Vitus-II, was quiet work but ultimately essential to his development. Until Kathor Navrak and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.actors.Actor.gw1UiYXapR7TRNHF]{Calis DeGuar} enacted their plan and destroyed the Manufactorum, Tybaris Arx spent his days overseeing the manufactorum’s machinery and output, while gradually learning the rejuvenat reagent’s various applications.

In captivity, he is constantly watched by a pair of gangers, and often by Kathor Navrak himself, knowing that the Tech-Priest is just as valuable, if not more, than the equipment he stole from Manufactorum Vitus-II. But Arx is no fool, he knows Navrak will eventually dispose of him, once the Vylathi Knives’ leader truly understands that Arx cannot deliver the rejuvenat treatments he desires.

But Arx has a great deal of patience as a Tech-Priest. He has secretly hacked apart a vox-comm unit among the manufactorum’s pilfered equipment to broadcast a signal indicating he is still alive, and potentially, his rough location. Otherwise, he quietly tolerates the idiotic gang leader’s experiments while waiting for a moment to strike back and potentially escape.

Tybaris Arx uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Tech-Priest} stat-block, except the Vylathi Knives have relieved him of his Plasma Pistol and other possessions.

notes.player: Each member of Echo Team is either ex-@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.r6JYS3jOfrAEorvd]{Astra Militarum}, ex-@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Navy,} or ex-vigilite. Captain Polis forbids anyone without military bearing and experience onto her team and has some disdain for common mercenaries and fighters. Each trooper is well-armed, armoured, and capable. They look to Pollis and Cole for orders in any situation, but are also experienced and capable of executing even without their officers around.

These Beastmen are touched by Chaos, making them even bigger and stronger than their brethren. Some have grown tentacles, while others gain an extra eye or limb. Such signs are considered a blessing among Talgore’s followers, so Mutated Beastmen are elevated to the shaman’s inner circle, answering only to Talgore himself.

Among the Officio Assasinorum’s temples, Eversor Assassins are by far the least subtle agents. These berserkers must be loaded into single‑occupant Drop Pods while still in stasis, stirring to wakefulness only as their craft streaks down upon the target zone and cranial augmetics inload the Assassin’s mission into their mind. Once free, potent combat stimms drive Eversor Assassins to superhuman levels of speed, strength and aggression. Armed with needle‑clawed neuro‑gauntlets, thrumming power swords, executioner pistols and even bunker-busting melta bombs, there is no target an Eversor cannot run down and butcher.

notes.gm:
‘A large, stocky man with a shaggy beard and thinning hair stretches the stiffness from his thickly muscled arms as an odour of oil and old sweat hangs thickly about him.’

Larn Boris is a stern figure who has become something of an unofficial leader to the rest of the Devotion’s menials. With a dangerous reputation, he is fond of throwing his weight around. He often clashes with @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#sergeant-drukos]{Sergeant Drukos} and has found himself locked in the brig after bouts of drunken and disorderly behaviour.

Menial Boris uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourer} stat-block.

notes.player: The pitiful former leader of the Beastmen, and one who entirely swallowed the tale that all Beastmen are monsters who owe a debt to the God-Emperor and His Imperium. His horns have been shorn from his head, his few loyal followers slain, and he is imprisoned in a cage as a warning to anyone who would shy away from Talgore’s glorious purpose. His treatment at the hands of Talgore’s followers has weakened him in body and mind.

Acynadi Delta-5 are about the size of a steed when standing fully upright. Their clawed spindly legs are perfect for climbing and setting up vertical ambushes. These variants have rarely been spotted in groups of more than three or four at a time.

Captain Karina Pollis is an ex-@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1]{Astra Militarum} officer. Her demeanour, like that of her team, is no-nonsense. She does everything she can to execute her mission as efficiently and timely as possible. She has a distinct limp, caused by her left leg being replaced with an augmetic one, blown off in the battle that had her pulled from the frontlines. General Borum Castyx ensured her recovery and spared her from being re-deployed as a quartermaster, knowing she’d still make an excellent spearhead for his elite squad.

Yarneg rules over the Lower Hive fighting pit, ‘The Dreg’. He’s managed to remain independent from Rokarths’ gangs by offering a refuge for anyone, so long as they have something to gamble away, and by cultivating his own force of grafted gangers to protect his small sliver of territory. He elevates his most loyal and successful fighters by gifting them grafted muscle treatments and augmetics, applied by back-alley medicae practitioners. Many among Yarneg’s lower ranks see these augments as a point of prestige, and Yarneg knows this, using the promise of reward to solidify his influence over them.

Magos Vark inspected Maltus Refinery VI a year or so back, but no longer conducts inspections himself as he has a senior but secret role in Forge-Fane Incalcos-6. He does have an impeccable memory and can recall that particular inspection perfectly. He describes how the refinery was not properly maintained, and that conditions were so poor that workers were becoming too ill to work. Though no urgent repairs were necessary, the Magos recommended that many restoratory procedures be undertaken to appease the machine spirits. He is not confident that @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.actors.Actor.BMt1lzDVRMWAsuQk]{Lord Felputh} paid any attention to these recommendations. Certainly, the suggestion that the noble might wish to contribute to the Tech-Priesthood was ignored.

Once a man of some means, Calis DeGuar’s fortunes have fallen precipitously in the last few days, resulting in the creation of Barsis Vand, his new alter ego, as a means to survive the fallout surrounding the destruction of Manufactorum Vitus-II.

DeGuar’s former, modest finery has been abandoned for rags that allow him to pass unremarked among the dregs of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth}. Only his size gives him away, though far from wealthy, DeGuar’s position afforded him enough solars to eat much better than most. Beneath his ragged robes, he has something of a paunch, and he has recently acquired the habit of tapping his soft, unblemished fingers on any nearby tabletop. He has been under tremendous stress lately and has hardly slept in the last few days. Tired, yellowing eyes dart back and forth under heavy lids overseen by thick, greying brows.

The manufactorum workforce he managed is considered dead, and DeGuar used this catastrophe to orchestrate his own supposed death and cover his tracks. DeGuar’s position at Manufactorum Vitus-II was a relatively prestigious appointment by the standards of the mid-levels of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth}. The site produced a precious chemical precursor key to rejuvenat treatments. The Manufactorum was a significant holding of House Nethecaré in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth}, with further ties to trade with the Mercator Lenimen, leaving DeGuar exceptionally well-connected for a man of his station.

After accruing a sizable gambling debt with the Vylathi Knives far beyond his means to repay, DeGuar made a deal. His entire workforce would be surrendered to the Knives under the cover of the manufactorum’s demolition, the workers would be written off as killed in the ‘accident,’ and he would retain a large quantity of the precursor agent. He hoped to use his contacts to sell this valuable material and start a new life elsewhere on Voll. DeGuar was as naive as he was desperate, however. The Knives took the workers and kept the precursor for themselves, leaving the former Overseer destitute with a burning desire for revenge.

Calis DeGuar is now left in a precarious position. He has allowed Barsis Vand, his alter ego, to come to the attention of the party’s Patron in hopes of directing investigations towards the Vylathi Knives without implicating himself. However, he may reveal his true identity if he overplays his hand. The punishment for what he has done could be dire — if he is lucky, the Tech-Priest responsible for rendering his body for use as a servitor will be swift and efficient in discharging their duties.

A creature of pale skin, misshapen limbs, and a face that is half youthful and half ancient, a visage twisted by mutation. The thing that was Lerna Harrog spends her days in the depths of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth's} effluent purification systems, she emerges only at night to scavenge for scraps and drag herself time and time again back to the ruins of the old manufactorum. Though it pained her, that was the only place she could remember, where flashes of her life before could still be glimpsed.

Harrog was a manufactorum labourer at Manufactorum Vitus-II. After the Vylathi Knives captured her, she was subjected to Navrak’s ad-hoc rejuvenat experiments and became a mutant because of it.

The mutations have greatly clouded her mind. She remembers some of her imprisonment — somewhere dark that smelled oddly familiar. There had been work there, too, harder than before, and then there was the man above — Kathor Navrak. He had asked her if she wanted relief from her labour and, more importantly, if she wanted to be young forever.

She said yes, of course. Then, the great mechanised hinges sealed her in as the green fluid swallowed her up. Later, she awoke in the sewers amidst a tangle of bodies as twisted as her own — others Navrak experimented on — but she was the only survivor.

The rest of Venykar’s Sanctifiers wear large black robes with shrouds that cover their faces. Hand-stitched Imperial slogans and prayers are embroidered unevenly across their robes. They carry incense burners, candelabras, holy icons, vox-casters that blare holy litanies, and flamers slung at their sides. The cultists are fanatics ready to enact extreme violence in the God-Emperor’s name at any moment. It is only the fear of Caul’s retribution and the confidence their leader exudes that holds them at bay. By his command, they do not hesitate to burn everything around them with purifying flame.

notes.gm:
A tall, thin man, Kathor Navrak, wears a long red coat of ruined finery. A greasy cascade of tangled shoulder-length hair falls over his shoulder in misshapen yet elaborate knots. A sharp nose sits off-centre in a white powdered face, split by a smile equal parts charming and predatory. His unsettling visage is punctuated by the sinister glint of two silver teeth. 

Kathor Navrak has never considered himself cruel, but cruelty has always followed in his wake. Navark was once a technician employed by House Nethecaré, a noble house granted the rare right to pursue its own studies into matters of biochemical research. Navrak exceeded all boundaries placed upon his studies and, despite minor successes, was forced to flee his former masters.

Perhaps their name — taken either in emulation or spite from another noble house — drew Navrak to the Vylathi Knives. He has promised the gang’s leadership that he could grant them the long lives of the nobles they ape, and in return, all he has asked is for the means to pursue his own interests.

Navrak found that it was a simple task to draw DeGuar into the gang’s schemes, recognising him as a weak man in a position beyond his means, ripe for exploitation. His new allies within the Knives were old hands at putting pressure on a chosen victim, and soon Navrak had the chemicals and workers needed, along with a Tech-Preist — albeit a relatively junior one. Navrak had never envied the Cult of Mars their privileges, and he surprised himself with how satisfying it was to have a Tech-Priest under his power.

Though his efforts have yielded no useful results — the Tech-Priest insists the protocol is impossible to employ with the means at his disposal — Navrak is far from frustrated. He finally has everything he ever desired; a laboratory to lead, a pliant workforce, and the respect he has so long deserved. Success is only a matter of time, so long as he can find sufficient ‘volunteers.’

Kathor Navrak uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.kdhQ2SwO7Vm2rzUI]{Gang Leader} stat-block.

notes.player:
Markis Sihn knew he was different from others in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-dalal]{Hive Dalal} at a young age. He had abilities that made some fear him and others worship him. Yet, he fell out of favour with the citizenry of Hive Dalal, washed out of the city and landed in the wastes among the world’s lowliest labourers. Once he picked himself up and began building his cult of personality, he met @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.actors.Actor.CQH3R36NIhE0JyQ9]{Adriana Corbid}. He knew she was highborn, but the two quickly fell for each other.  

In the wastes, Sihn began having visions of an unblinking eye, thinking it a message from the God-Emperor. Whispers in his mind told him that only he could heal the downtrodden people of the waste. So he did just that, and soon, Sihn and Corbid began to build the Court of Sihn. Utilising her noble connections and his powers, the two rose in prominence, allying with disparate groups in the waste and healing those in need — with that, Markis Sihn cemented his own mythology. 

Sihn envisages independence for the people of Voll’s wastelands, but he knows they are still far from starting a revolution. Except recently, the whispers and visions that Sihn experiences have gotten worse. He now fully believes he is a conduit for a greater power that is helping the wastelanders throw off the yoke of the world’s noble houses.

This ogryn is Caul’s primary enforcer. He is tattooed from head to toe in Imperial slogans and prayers, wears little clothing other than a large loincloth, sandals, and a large black shroud, and carries a massive heavy flamer with extra fuel tanks slung over his back. The front of the shroud is always open, displaying his holy tattoos and enormous frame. Agorax speaks little other than to scream Imperial litanies in battle or warn people to stay away from Caul. Agorax is certain that Caul’s mission is holy and sent from the God-Emperor, and believes his salvation for being born abhuman is through service to Caul.

Ramm Kragon is a former merchant fleet trader hiding from his past. After his voidship suffered a minor Geller Field failure, costing him most of his crew and right arm, he decided to cash out. Whoever or whatever he saw in the Warp shook him to the bone. He fled the merchant fleet with his favourite Servo-skull and servitor and a tidy sum of solars he’d banked over the years. He landed in Voll’s wastelands, hoping to escape court-martial and whatever Warp-borne force he encountered that day. Eventually, he opened a small bar using the solars in his possession, and the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9.JournalEntryPage.eiMwmm7AQZLlFOkn#e.-kragons-flask]{Flask} was established. 

Kragon is not a fighter, but he does carry a bolt pistol and wears a flak vest. Even with his guards, his business can get dangerous. He always has his @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.px7pplClKR01chqM]{Servitor} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.Y6oJff3F4qo2Xhlx]{Servo-skull} with him, which have been modified to be helpful in a fight (the Servo-skull wields a concealed @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tDe1U5EtxPowhYKn]{Web Pistol} and the Servitor is equipped with a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.DSKAdYMPRHvadLZz]{Shock Maul}.

notes.gm:
‘An ageing man with bright blue eyes sits atop a spider-legged support throne. While the unnerving, oiled device bristles with bone saws and grisly medicae attachments, he wears a warm smile across his thin, cracked lips.’

Medicae Stellan Roderick serves as primary medical officer, along with a small staff of assistants and servitors, he tends to the crew’s health. A jovial fellow known as one of the more approachable officers aboard, having garnered a reputation as something of a kindly father. He can sometimes be found in @UUID[JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.vC2n6yi7x19C9HvR#b2.-the-mess]{the Mess}, though his visits are seldom, rarely leaving the @UUID[JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.vC2n6yi7x19C9HvR#b1.-the-medicae-ward]{Medicae Ward} in which he quarters. 

In truth, Medicae Roderick is @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.3BlX4i31o2Wez7vh#vesterick-nethecare]{Vesterick Nethecaré}, an embittered, revenge-obsessed noble eager to mar the reputation of House Nethecaré as the primary villain of this adventure. He took advantage of his self-appointed position to extract blood samples, analyse biometrics, and monitor how his chemical agent affected the crew. 

Medicae Roderick is behind the murder of Captain Veridian, crushing his throat with one of his Medicae Servitors. The Captain had uncovered that the initial data supplied to the crew on the expedition’s goals was false and moved to send word. Though he uses a support throne, Vesterick Nethecaré can move without it. 

He keeps a close eye on the proceedings of the investigation through the listening device he implanted in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#curator-varness]{Curator Varness}’s augmentic arm. Roderick (@UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.3BlX4i31o2Wez7vh#vesterick-nethecare]{Vesterick Nethecaré}) uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.ncXwqNsh38L8CyRo]{Smuggler} stat-block.

notes.player: Kesker was a shift leader at the manufactorum before Felputh replaced the workers with Beastmen — he knows the layout of Maltus Refinery VI like the back of his hand. He coughs incessantly. Since then, he and most of the local workers have been on reduced rations, punishment for the ‘trouble’ he caused. All are expecting reassignment somewhere soon. He knows he hasn’t long left before the Bloodlung kills him.

notes.gm:
‘The old man’s left arm and leg are terribly atrophied, and he walks with a pained hunchbacked gait. A wide grin of sparse yellow teeth sits below a pair of white, blind eyes. Despite his kindly smile, a coldness seems to emanate from him.’

Taj ‘Old’ Hinji is as much a fixture of @UUID[JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.vC2n6yi7x19C9HvR#b2.-the-mess]{the Mess} as are the rusted tables and dingy smell. He is often stationed at his post, doling out slop or mumbling about his strange visions. Others accept these stories as the ramblings of an old drunkard on the verge of senility, and entertainment is a hard thing to come by aboard the dark decks of the Devotion. 

Once an artillerist of his home world’s planetary defence forces, he was subsequently blinded and suffered severe spinal damage during his first engagement, leaving him atrophied and unfit for combat. Sometime later, he assisted @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#sergeant-drukos]{Sergeant Drukos} and his band of deserters in escaping their home world, and they took him along as something of a good luck charm for his new band of renegade mercenaries. This proved a wise move, as often old Hinji’s prodigious skill at gambling has kept them in food and shelter. During this time, Hinji and the rest of Druko’s band became associates of The @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#criminal-cartels]{Trackless Chain}. 

The truth is that Old Hinji is a latent psyker, unaware of his potential, and entirely undeveloped. Yet he subconsciously picks up on the twisted thoughts and memories of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.3BlX4i31o2Wez7vh#vesterick-nethecare]{Vesterick Nethecaré}’s chemical-addled mind, unknowingly projecting them. If questioned about any of the strange happenings that seem to follow him, be it his skill at cards, his seizures or his stories, he answers truthfully that he doesn't know where they come from; it all seems to come to him somehow.

Represent Old Hinji using the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourer} stat-block, except he has the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent of which he is unaware and permanently has the Blinded Condition.

notes.player: The rank and file of Heldrax’s Stalkers are chosen for their ability to follow orders, move stealthily, and kill with speed and efficiency. They are armed with mono-edged swords as their primary assassination tool, but they also carry autopistol when they need to ‘go loud’. Protecting Heldrax is always their primary concern unless he orders otherwise — these actions are made out of loyalty to their leader as it is their fear of Trissa Vant.

Lieutenant Alfarius Cole is ex-@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1]{Imperial Navy}, something that Captain Pollis never lets him forget. Cole is a competent officer who focuses less on fighting and more on strategy and tactics. He is essential to Echo Team as its central communications officer, and with his great personality, everyone likes and respects him. If Cole is not in the middle of relaying comms or distributing orders, he has his dataslate in hand, trying to find a new angle of attack for the captain. If pressed, Cole is a crack shot with his plasma pistol.

Beastmen vary significantly in appearance and attitude, but all feature bestial traits: claws, hooves, horns, tusks, and so on. They tend to be larger than most Humans, heavily muscled and rugged, fast and agile.

notes.gm:
‘Tattered crimson robes stretch tightly over a hulking mass of tool-tipped bionics, six yellow eye lenses swivel and click as Mathus-49 hangs spider-like, supported by dozens of thick mechadendrites.’

Mathus-49 oversees all maintenance rituals that the Interminable Devotion may require, along with the upkeep of its servitor population. Mathus-49 has a reputation for being uncooperative, and this behaviour extends to the characters — but given the age of the Capitol Imperalis, the Tech-Priest has his mechadendrites full keeping the ancient engine going.

Malthus-49 uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Tech-Priest} stat-block.

notes.player:
Rastigan Dorin is an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Adeptus Administratum} sub-prefect who oversees planetary region Gamma-74. He grew up in the service of the Adeptus Administratum in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-dalal]{Hive Dalal}, always under the watchful eye of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.AgChFLsZYrdMa2pS#nethecare]{House Nethecaré}. In turn, Dorin watched and envied these nobles from afar. When rumours reached his ears of a rebel operating in his region, one thumbing their nose at the wealthy highborn and their corrupt operations, Dorin knew he had to be a part of it. 

Dorin donned a mask and sought out the fledgling Court of Sihn, maintaining his anonymity among their ranks to this day. He plied his influence within @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9.JournalEntryPage.eiMwmm7AQZLlFOkn#a.-aserion-outpost]{Aserion Outpost} to protect Sihn and grow the court’s operations, quickly rising in rank within the cult. His position allows him to warn Sihn of dangers, often misdirecting those seeking to harm Sihn into the wastes where raiders and the dangers of the landscape can dispose of them.

But now, all his schemes and plans have started to unravel. Adriana Corbid has become distrustful of him, and Dorin can tell.

notes.gm:
‘The whip-thin man clutches tightly to the stained fabric of his overalls. Patchy stubble underpins his features while dark circles hang heavy under a pair of cold blue eyes.’

Scribe Gallant Hess is a naturally unlikeable fellow; most of the crew speak of him with a measure of disdain. He is staunchly devoted to the God-Emperor as if he were an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.5Bx7K8k9VgjOZmA4]{Adeptus Ministorum} preacher. In the dark reaches of the Enginarium Decks far from prying eyes, the scribe flagellates himself in the name of the God-Emperor and steals medical supplies from the Hangar to patch himself up.

Scribe Hess uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Administratum Adept} stat-block.

‘A powerfully built yet hawkish man dressed in standard grey and black Astra-Militarum fatigues stares at you, baring a grimace of crooked yellow teeth, twisting across his face like a tangle of barbed wire.’

Sergeant Bull Drukos oversees much of the daily security work, primarily consisting of liaising with @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#curator-varness]{Curator Varness} and handing out watch rotations. Yet in the rare instances of insubordination, crime, or unrest on the Devotion, it falls to Sergeant Drukos and his men to deal with any disturbance of the peace, arrest those responsible, and perform any subsequent executions. 

This grim role of executioner only adds to his dour demeanour and has led him to be something of a social outcast amongst most of the other crew. His few forays into @UUID[JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.vC2n6yi7x19C9HvR#b2.-the-mess]{the Mess} are met with shaky salutes and lowered gazes. This contrasts greatly with his friendship with @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#old-hinji]{Old Hinji}, who delights in Drukos’ visits. The two can be seen talking and sharing meals. While Hinji’s status as a beloved figure amongst the crew spares him much scrutiny, no one can understand this relationship. 

The hidden truth is that the two men have known each other long before they set foot aboard the Devotion’s ancient bones. Drukos is a deserter of the imperial guard, having led a small band including @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ.JournalEntryPage.u9wPwSqM2FTyo8pg#old-hinji]{Old Hinji} off-world and into exile on the sector fringe during siege operations against a heavily fortified traitor stronghold. Once free, he forged this group into a band of mercenaries that undertook protection work for a time with @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#criminal-cartels]{The Trackless Chain}).

Sergeant Drukos uses the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Commissar} stat-block, except he wields the same weapons and equipment as his men. Use the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.ZIodTiyH9W5QBRU9]{Astra Militarum Trooper} stat-block to represent Drukos’s team.

notes.player: Sandik does not suffer Disadvantage when attacking with two ranged weapons at the same time. See @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#two-weapon-fighting]{Two-weapon Fighting} for more information.

While in the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9.JournalEntryPage.eiMwmm7AQZLlFOkn#f.-the-float]{Float}, as an Action, Trace can call for backup on her Vox Bead. All Marauders hear this call within 1 mile. Backup usually arrives in [[/r 1d5]] Rounds and consists of a mix of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.ZUWBWGM4eH7xFZ8P]{Dregs} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.bB0rMr6Gez3M9bME]{Gangers}.

Designed to fit inside the user's ear, these communication tools let someone effortlessly talk to and hear others on the same vox channel. As their range is far beyond shouting, and work in situations where shouting would call dangerous attention, they are almost essential for mission outfitting.

This item allows the wearer to communicate with other users on the same channel within a mile, though dense metallic obstructions and violent weather can lessen or disrupt the ability.

Refractor Fields emit a soft glow and crackle while active, a sure sign that the user has far more than the Emperor's protection to ward them from harm. While often a glorious radiance, the light is detrimental to most covert activities.

While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.
As an Action, Trace may make a Challenging (+0) Presence (Leadership) Test. For every SL, a member of Trace’s Marauders within Medium Range may spend their Reaction to take an immediate action.

Dataslates can be found everywhere in the Imperium and are the most common way to store recorded data of all kinds. They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.
Restax has Advantage on all Piloting Tests in her Cargo-8, including any Tech Tests to repair or maintain it.

These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.

Survival Gear encompasses a wide range of equipment designed for long durations in wilderness areas, including the crumbling habways of destroyed cities and other areas where basic necessities are unavailable. Though bulky, they can mean the difference between life and death in areas where no one might ever find the remains.

Each Survival Gear pack includes items such as a bedroll, insulated tent, canteen, rope, firestarters, candles, hydro-purifier tabs, and other basics except for actual food and water. Survival Gear can be used in combination with Fortitude (Endurance) to endure @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#exposure]{Exposure}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Training in the Imperial Creed, including various sects and interpretations. Passing knowledge of the Cult Mechanicus. Only cursory knowledge at best of any heretical sects of the Imperial Creed and none whatsoever of any forbidden cults. Theology requires at least 1 Advance in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.uIycnZ1DuUJFFO0c]{Linguistics (High Gothic)}.

The Harbinger has grown adept at swinging his power sycthe in wide, destructive arcs. In his hands the weapon gains the Spread Trait, though his attacks never target himself. If his allies fall to his blade, however, this is no less than the Emperor’s will.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of larger swords, bigger axes, heavier maces, and other melee weapons that require two hands to use, along with various polearms such as spears and halberds.
The Harbinger is immune to the Frightened Condition.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Better aptitude at swimming through liquids, typically water. Essential on some worlds with planet-spanning oceans, and almost unknown on others.

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

notes.player: Lord Felputh is always sure he’s right, even when he’s lying. He gains +1 Resolve and Advantage on any Social Test, except when engaging with a character of higher social or Imperial rank.

Designed to fit inside the user's ear, these communication tools let someone effortlessly talk to and hear others on the same vox channel. As their range is far beyond shouting, and work in situations where shouting would call dangerous attention, they are almost essential for mission outfitting.

This item allows the wearer to communicate with other users on the same channel within a mile, though dense metallic obstructions and violent weather can lessen or disrupt the ability.

Rebreathers employ small air tanks as well as recycling systems so that the user can breathe normally for some time in toxic atmospheres and even underwater.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.

A Chrono is a basic, though often overlooked, item used to determine the time. Resourceful folk use Chronos to synchronise their actions.

Chronos display the current time and, if the planet supports it, automatically adjust to local time after only a few seconds on the ground.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Mentally hardened to stand firm in the face of the unnatural fear caused by exposure to heretical and corrupt beings. Fear is often used to resist and recover from the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.

Fire bombs are ancient explosives, dating back to the unknowable past when Humans first discovered that certain liquids were flammable. Promethium or other exotic substances are placed in fragile containers, fitted with burning cloth or electronic igniters, and hurled. The container bursts on impact, spreading flaming liquid across a wide area. Due to their ease of construction, crude bombs are found on almost all Imperial worlds, and the flames they spread are often the first signs of an uprising.

You can make a Ranged Attack to target an enemy with a Fire Bomb. The target is set @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze}. Alternatively, you can target a Zone with a Fire Bomb. A Fire Bombs turns a Zone it hits into a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Minor Hazard} for three rounds. This duration can be extended or shortened depending on the amount of flammable material in the Zone, such as arid forests or rain-slicked spires.

Chronos display the current time and, if the planet supports it, automatically adjust to local time after only a few seconds on the ground.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae}

Advanced training in treating disease and injuries in Humans. Used for first aid, stabilising the heavily injured, and stopping bleeding. Despite the name, it will work on Abhumans such as Ratlings, Ogryn, and Kin of the Leagues of Votann.

Dataslates can be found everywhere in the Imperium and are the most common way to store recorded data of all kinds. They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Trained to inspire others to put in their best efforts to achieve a desired goal. This can range anywhere from motivating a few clerks to finish a long survey in record time, to giving a group of desperate soldiers the courage to charge a fortified enemy bunker.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
The Overseer has a Resolve of 3 whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.

Cognomens: Blast, Empyric Screech, Eldritch Undoing

You unleash a corruscating blast of raw psychic power against a foe, rending flesh and spirit. Choose a Creature within Medium Range. The target suffers Damage equal to 2 + your Willpower Bonus + the SL from your Manifest Test, which ignores Armour.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Verminspeak, Rat-tongue, Crawlers Plea

You summon and compel simple creatures to fly or scurry at your whim. Until the start of your next turn, you gain control of vermin in the area (you don't need to see them), amassing them as a swarm that fills one Zone within Medium Range. If the vermin crawl, the swarm's Zone is @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#difficult-terrain]{Difficult Terrain}. If the swarm flies, its Zone is @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#obscured]{Lightly Obscured}. As a free action once on your turn, you can command the swarm to move to an adjacent Zone within Long Range of you.

Alternatively, you can summon and control a single vermin, which emerges within Medium Range. As a free action once on your turn, you can direct it to perform a simple task, such as fetching a keycard or gnawing through bindings.

You immediately lose control of vermin beyond Medium Range. This power does not grant you the ability to communicate with vermin, only command them.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#linguistics-(int)]{Linguistics}

Those possessed of this skill understand a language or form of communication that is either highly restricted or prohibited within the Imperium. With few exceptions, it is considered heretical to know the languages of aliens; however, the Sisters of the Orders Dialogus are frequently granted special dispensation from the Adeptus Ministorum to learn such in pursuit of their duties. Some xenos languages, such as the Kroot’s, are unpronounceable by a Human tongue without augmentation. While some languages are considered too profane to speak, others are too holy for common knowledge. The Lingua-technis of the Adeptus Mechanicus is a forbidden language that few outside their order have ever learned, in part, because it is based on binary machine code that all but the most gifted individuals require cybernetic implants to speak. Thoughtmark, the form of sign language used by the Sisters of Silence, is also known to very few outsiders. Each Forbidden Language requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. When Talgore Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

Cognomens: Death's Visage, The Emperor's Gaze, Unsettle

You invoke the Warp's terrifying nature to exude a dreadful presence, inciting irrational fear in enemies near you. Until the start of your next turn, the first time an enemy enters your Zone in a round or starts its turn there, it must win a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Fear) Test Opposed by your Manifest Test or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. If a creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.
When Talgore makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.
Arkt Talgore can use the following Minor Psychic Powers: Call Vermin, Dread Presence, Smite.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
As an Action, a Vigilite can call for backup. All Macharian Vigilites in a 1 mile radius respond in [[/r 1d10]] Rounds (or minutes if out of combat).

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

The essential tool of bounty hunters and Enforcers alike, Manacles help ensure a bounty, criminal, or heretic remains helpless and more easily transported to their awaiting fate.

You can use an Action to apply Manacles to an unresisting character's wrists or ankles, including those with the Restrained (Minor), Stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#unconscious]{Unconscious} Conditions. While Manacles are in place, that target is Incapacitated. Manacles come with keys or a code to lock and unlock the heavy steel cuffs. Otherwise, a Very Hard (−30) Dexterity (Lock Picking), Athletics (Might) or Tech (Security) Test is needed to remove them. This Test is made with Disadvantage if the user is attempting to unlock themself.

Manacles can be destroyed by dealing 10 Damage to them.
When a Vigilite is Grappling an individual they can Manacle them as a Free Action

Designed to fit inside the user's ear, these communication tools let someone effortlessly talk to and hear others on the same vox channel. As their range is far beyond shouting, and work in situations where shouting would call dangerous attention, they are almost essential for mission outfitting.

This item allows the wearer to communicate with other users on the same channel within a mile, though dense metallic obstructions and violent weather can lessen or disrupt the ability.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Aptitude in a variety of techniques designed to elicit answers out of a subject. A skilled interrogator implies pressure in many ways, subtle and not, in order to discover as much information as they can, even when a subject is cooperative. Interrogation is not physical torture, though undergoing a long interrogation may certainly feel agonising. Interrogation is opposed by the target's @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Endurance (Pain)}.

If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
Heldrax can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of his Movement if the Zone he is in has Cover.

Refractor Fields emit a soft glow and crackle while active, a sure sign that the user has far more than the Emperor's protection to ward them from harm. While often a glorious radiance, the light is detrimental to most covert activities.

While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.

These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.

Synskin is a highly advanced tight-fitting body glove made of spectrally inert non-reflective fabrics that also dissipate or mask heat signatures to allow the wearer to disappear into the dark as well as provide a modicum of protection against attackers who do manage to detect them.

Synskin counts as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.sYDTAe3hDjoSD0Gb]{Armoured Bodyglove}. If it is not worn in addition to other clothing or armour, the Synskin grants +1 SL to Stealth (Hide) Tests.
Heldrax has Advantage on Stealth Tests if he does not move that turn.

The choice of garb for snipers and thieves alike, this cloak covers the entire body and uses exotic mimic fibres that automatically shift colouration to match the surroundings. If you do not move during your turn while wearing a Cameleoline Cloak, you gain +2 SL on Stealth Tests until you move or make a loud noise.

If an enemy is wounded within Short Range of Heldrax he can use his Reaction to order a Heldrax’s Stalkers member within hearing to make an immediate Action against that target (this uses the character’s Reaction).

Cognomens: Farseeing Gaze, Eyes of the Warp

Physical distance has little meaning in the Warp, so you can peer through that dimension to locate and observe targets anywhere. Choose a creature, object, or location you've observed firsthand. Over the course of a minute, you send your senses through the Warp to observe the target. You can see and hear the target. If you score 4 or more SL on your Manifest Test, you know the target's approximate direction and distance from you and can also see and hear the Zone surrounding it.

A Psyker or daemon senses it is being observed if its Perception Bonus is higher than your Willpower Bonus. If it's aware of your observation, it can use an Action on its turn to make a Easy (+40) Discipline (Psychic) Test Opposing your Manifest Test, ending the power immediately if it wins. If the target wins the Opposed Test, it can't be targeted by this power again for the next hour.

Cognomens: Death's Visage, The Emperor's Gaze, Unsettle

You invoke the Warp's terrifying nature to exude a dreadful presence, inciting irrational fear in enemies near you. Until the start of your next turn, the first time an enemy enters your Zone in a round or starts its turn there, it must win a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Fear) Test Opposed by your Manifest Test or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. If a creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Mercurial Suspension, Arcane Lofting

You free yourself from gravity's constraints, floating weightlessly. Until the start of your next turn, you float suspended in space. While floating, you can move at Slow Speed in any direction, ignoring Difficult Terrain.

Alternatively, you can touch an object within Immediate Range and reduce its Encumbrance by 1 per SL until the start of your next turn.

Specialisation in Telekinesis applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Daemonic Plea, Echos of the Empyrean

You enter a minute-long trance, casting your soul into the immaterium to search for answers, but the Warp is home to manipulative forces and should never be fully trusted. Within the roiling power of the Warp lies every truth, every lie and the knowledge of past, future and present. A psyker who is desperate enough can attempt to pluck a sliver of knowledge from within the Empyrean, although whether it is a glimpse of the future, a skein of wisdom or the lies of daemonkind are anyone's guess…

When you manifest this power, ask the GM a question you don't know the answer to. The GM secretly rolls [[/r 1d10]] and compares it to the sum of your Willpower Bonus + the SL from your Manifest Test (maximum 9). If the d10 roll is less than the sum, the GM answers truthfully. If the d10 roll is greater than or equal to the sum, the GM's answer is false. Regardless of the veracity, once this power provides an answer, you can't ask the same question again.

Cognomens: Spark, Inflame, The Will to Fire

Your connection to the Warp momentarily manifests an intense mote of flame, seemingly from nothing. Choose a flammable object within Medium Range. The target catches fire and burns normally. If the target is held or worn by a creature, the creature must drop or remove the item before the end of its next turn or become @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze} until it or another creature within Immediate Range uses an Action to extinguish it.

Specialisation in Pyromancy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Emperor's Guidance, Warp fluke

You invoke the fickle nature of the Warp to tilt probability in your favour. When you must make a Test, you can attempt to manifest this power immediately before making that Test. If you manifest it, you make the Test with Advantage. If you fail to manifest it, you make the Test with Disadvantage. This power cannot be used to augment Psychic Mastery Tests, and it cannot be used more than once per Round.

Specialisation in Divination applies to this power's Manifest Test.
Caul has 1 point of Fate.
Caul has a Warp Threshold equal to double his Willpower bonus.

Cognomens: Auger, Foresee

You dare consult the Warp to gain insights into the possible futures awaiting you, preparing you for what's to come. During a Rest, you can spend 10 minutes in a Divinatory trance to examine the possible futures presented to you by the Warp. At the end of the trance, you gain a number of Prescience Points equal to the SL from your Manifest Test.

After you make a Test, you can spend one of your Prescience Points to reroll one or both dice from the Test, using the result of the new roll to resolve the Test. Advantage and Disadvantage apply after the roll as normal. You can't spend more than one Prescience Point on a Test.

Prescience Points do not expire, but you lose any unspent Points the next time you manifest this power.

Cognomens: Tabula Rasa, Arcane Equalisation

The Warp doesn't distinguish between good and bad fortune, and you invoke that cosmic ambivalence to blur the line between them. Once during a round when a creature within Short Range (including you) makes a Test with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can attempt to manifest this power as a Reaction. If successful, the creature makes the Test with neither Advantage nor Disadvantage. If you fail your Manifest Test, you fall victim to the Warp's fickle nature, forcing you to make Tests with Disadvantage until you have 0 Warp Charge.

Cognomens: Daemon's Eyes, Part the Veil

You augment your biology to grant yourself enhanced senses beyond those typical of your species. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following effects:

  • You ignore penalties from Zones with the Poorly Lit and Dark Environmental Traits

  • You can see the heat patterns of living creatures through solid walls up to medium range.

  • You gain Advantage to Perception Tests.

Additionally, if you score at least 5 SL on your Manifest Test, you can sense creatures, objects, and movement using senses other than sight, allowing you to ignore the Blinded condition.

Specialisation in Biomancy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Glimpse, Prickle

Flashes of foresight warn you of impending danger, allowing you the chance to manoeuvre out of harm's way. Until the start of your next turn, you can take the Dodge Action as a Free Action on your turn.
When a psyker within Short Range of Caul Manifests a power, Caul may use his Reaction to make an immediate @UUID[.Pw1HijVPDKGXJYlM]{Hand Flamer} attack on the zone that psyker is in.

A Holy Icon might take any number of forms depending on an individual's faith and the specific version of the Imperial Creed they follow. For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

Refractor Fields emit a soft glow and crackle while active, a sure sign that the user has far more than the Emperor's protection to ward them from harm. While often a glorious radiance, the light is detrimental to most covert activities.

While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.

Cognomens: Assess, Numeromantic Index

You can scrutinise a creature's soul, glimpsing shreds of its future and past to glean vital information about its current state of being. Choose a creature within Short Range. For each SL of your Manifest Test, you learn one of the following pieces of information about the target:

  • Current and Maximum Wounds

  • Highest and Lowest Characteristic

  • One Characteristic's Value (your choice)

  • Most advanced Skill (GM's choice)

  • One Talent or Trait (GM's choice)

Specialisation in Divination applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Lifesense, The All Seeing Eye

Souls burn like flames in the darkness of the Warp, and you can attune your senses to detect them. Until the start of your next turn, you can sense the presence of living creatures within Medium Range according to the Soulsight Table. You can exclude specific creatures, such as you and your allies, from what this power detects. Additionally, you have Advantage to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lBzdm76EnuuoGfMq]{Psyniscience} Tests to detect or identify daemons or psykers while this power is active.

Specialisation in Divination applies to this power's Manifest Test.

When Gelka Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

Gelka does not suffer Disadvantage when attacking with two melee weapons at the same time. See @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#two-weapon-fighting]{Two-weapon Fighting} for more information.
When an enemy in Short Range of Heldrax attacks him, Vant may use her Reaction to make an immediate attack with her Sniper Rifle against that character.

If you do not move during your turn while wearing a Cameleoline Cloak, you gain +2 SL on Stealth Tests until you move or make a loud noise.

This tool set uses a coil of thin but robust rope, an attachment harness, and a multi-anchor to allow the user to rappel or climb with much more safety than they would have otherwise.

A climbing harness line is 50 metres in length and can support the weight of a Medium-sized creature or object. It takes an Action to set up a climbing harness. Additionally, the harness automatically arrests its payload should it detect the user falling too fast.
Trissa Vant has Advantage on Stealth Tests if she does not move that turn.

An Omnispex uses spectral sensors to analyse wavelengths outside of Human perception, so that even in darkness few can hide themselves from detection.

A Omnispex can be attached to most ranged weapons and removes Disadvantage when firing into a Zone that is @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#dark]{Dark} or @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#poorly-lit]{Poorly Lit}.

system.usedWith: Any Ranged Weapon without the Blast, or Flamer Traits.

notes.player:
Silencers use sonic bafflers and other devices to reduce the often loud and piercing retorts of weapons fire.

While attached, a Silencer removes a ranged weapon's @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#loud]{Loud} Trait.
