Popular among assassins and other fighters who need to pierce armour with ease, Mono-edges are molecule-thin superfine blades that never dull.

A Mono-edge can be applied to any Mundane bladed melee weapon, granting it the Penetrating (2) Trait, or increasing its Penetrating rating by 2 if it already has the Trait. At the GM's discretion, they may allow other Mundane weapons to use this modification. In this case, the modification takes the form of a powerful pneumatic spike or kill-plate.
Vant can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of their Movement if the Zone they are in has Cover.

These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

The Tech-Priest has @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.zK3ii7HUPfnQGKtg]{Augmetic Arms}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.PS24p896oNkNxwc4]{Augmetic Legs}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6VeObvauzrXSw5nO]{Augmetic Heart}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.gMiilnjEIZawYcfG]{Augmetic Respiratory System}, and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organs}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.DN4ZI8z7SqJjsney]{Utility Mechadendrite}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.2SkHTUxjqUxiyW6b]{Optical Mechadendrite}, and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.wRIE5K6YuMtymmm0]{Biomechanical Interface}. The benefits of these Augmetics are already included.
Can access cramped areas to give visual data and includes a stablight which can remove the Dark Environmental Trait from a Zone.
The Tech-Priest gains +1 SL to Tech Tests for operating a machine with a suitable connection, such as many vehicles, environmental processors, and manufactorum assemblers.

As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
The Tech-Priest gains +2 SL to Fortitude Tests to resist the effects of airborne toxins and poisonous gases.
Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.
Echo Team Troopers have Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.

Perhaps the most widely used Imperial military-grade munitions, Frag munitions are most commonly found in grenade and missile form. Both explode in showers of shrapnel and other lacertaing metals, making them ideal for anti-infantry duties. Almost every warrior in the Imperium, from Militarum troopers to elite Space Marines, carries frag grenades to aid in assaulting positions, with grenade launchers providing longer range infantry suppression. Frag missiles are the more powerful version, with a greater range to soften up distant positions such as heavy weapon teams.

Frag grenades have a large radius, and deal decent damage.

Survival Gear encompasses a wide range of equipment designed for long durations in wilderness areas, including the crumbling habways of destroyed cities and other areas where basic necessities are unavailable. Though bulky, they can mean the difference between life and death in areas where no one might ever find the remains.

Each Survival Gear pack includes items such as a bedroll, insulated tent, canteen, rope, firestarters, candles, hydro-purifier tabs, and other basics except for actual food and water. Survival Gear can be used in combination with Fortitude (Endurance) to endure @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#exposure]{Exposure}.

Rebreathers employ small air tanks as well as recycling systems so that the user can breathe normally for some time in toxic atmospheres and even underwater.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

For each Mutated Beastman encountered, roll [[/r 1d10]] to determine, or choose its mutation:

1-4: Extra Eye — The Mutated Beastman has grown extra eyes on its head or body. They have Advantage on Awareness (Sight) Tests.

5-7: Extra Limb — The Mutated Beastman has an extra limb. They may make an additional Hoof Strike or Unarmed attack during their turn.

8-0: Grasping Tentacle — The Mutated Beastman has grown a Tentacle. Its Unarmed attacks gain the Reach and Inflict (Restrained) Traits.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.
When a Mutated Beastman makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +2 SL on his next attack.
When a Mutated Beastman Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

Should Eversor Interitas perish, deeply embedded genetic kill codes trigger, driving what remains of his enhanced metabolism into overdrive. The resulting explosion threatens all those in Immediate Range, who must make a Difficult (−10) Reflexes (Dodge) Test or suffer [[/r 2d10]] damage to a random hit location.

An Eversor’s toxins are short-lived but particularly lethal. A Poisoned Condition inflicted by an Eversor’s weaponry has a duration of [[/r 1d5]][17:52]rounds, after which time the character must pass a  Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Poison) Test or die.

These powerful but unwieldy explosives are generally affixed to stationary targets via magnetic adhesion. They use technology similar to Melta weapons but concentrate their effects into a shaped charge; this makes them exceptionally lethal against even the strongest of armour plating and tank hulls.

Melta bombs deal very high damage and have the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rend-(rating)]{Rend} Trait, but only affect the target they are attached to.

Eversor Interitas is inhumanly fast, and acts twice each round — once on its own initiative, and once again at the end of the initiative order. Additionally, any time he inflicts a Critical Wound, he may immediately make another attack.
The Eversor’s reflexes have been enhanced far beyond Human limits. He may dodge any ranged attack, even ones he would seem to be unaware of.
The Eversor cannot be Surprised, and gains Advantage on all Awareness Tests.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Capacity for avoiding injury or accident through quick movements designed to sidestep the danger. Can be used to defend yourself in combat against melee and ranged attacks. While the unaugmented cannot directly dodge bullets, they can avoid being shot by swiftly removing themselves from the line of fire.

A mixture of bio-modification and auto-injected combat drugs such as Frenzon make Eversor Interitas immune to the Fatigued, Frightened, and Stunned Conditions. He also gains Advantage on any Test to resist mind-altering psychic powers and substances.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of handguns, such as laspistols, bolt pistols, autopistols, stub revolvers, and similar firearms.

These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

A Holy Icon might take any number of forms depending on an individual's faith and the specific version of the Imperial Creed they follow. For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.
When Mesk Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.
When Mesk makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.
Mesk only has access to this weapon if he can recover one or is given one by the characters.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.
The Acynadi Delta-5 can climb most surfaces without making a Test. When it attacks or defends against a target from above, it gains Advantage.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Better aptitude at swimming through liquids, typically water. Essential on some worlds with planet-spanning oceans, and almost unknown on others.

When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Delta-5 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

!actors.items!ZIxRrvXoXCRKAYyI.zYrbhbYLT.name: Its flesh can be butchered and sold for 3d10 solars to an appropriate vendor

notes.player: As an Action, Captain Pollis can target a Zone adjacent to one of her troopers and make a Challenging (+0) Presence (Leadership) Test. For each SL gained, a member of Echo Team within short range of her target Zone makes an immediate ranged attack on an enemy in that Zone.

Refractor Fields emit a soft glow and crackle while active, a sure sign that the user has far more than the Emperor's protection to ward them from harm. While often a glorious radiance, the light is detrimental to most covert activities.

While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.

Rebreathers employ small air tanks as well as recycling systems so that the user can breathe normally for some time in toxic atmospheres and even underwater.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.
Captain Pollis has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.

Legs are sometimes lost to industrial accidents, or infections contracted in the deathworld swamps. Augmetics restore a users locomotion, and tend to be more robust than their owners original limbs.

The leg grants +1 Armour, which is added to any other Armour in the location.

You gain +1 SL to all Strength-based Tests using the leg, such as kicking in a door.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

Unstable, grafted muscle implants reinforce this brute's frame. At the start of their turn, a Grafted Ganger may choose to add +5 SL to any Strength or Weapon Skill Tests until the end of their turn. If they do so, they take 5 Damage at the end of their turn which is not reduced by armour.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
The Gang Leader has +1 Resolve and Advantage on Discipline, Presence, Navigation, and Stealth Tests if it is in its own Gang's territory

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Practised at resisting charm, intimidation, and other social pressures. Those with strong Composure are gifted at maintaining their integrity in the face of temptation.

These Omnissiah-blessed lubricating oils can calm even the most recalcitrant of Machine Spirits, allowing them to operate with ease and ignore slights against their forms.

You can use Sacred Unguents 5 times. As an Action, you can make a Challenging (+0) Tech (Engineering) Test to apply Sacred Unguents to an Imperial technological item, vehicle, or weapon. If you succeed, the next time you fail a Test using the affected item, you re-roll the Test. After this re-roll, or if one day passes, the applied Sacred Unguents dry up and this effect ends. If you fail the Test to apply Sacred Unguents, you incorrectly apply the Unguents, or the machine spirit demands more to be appeased, either way you waste one use of Sacred Unguents.

These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.

A standard tool of many Imperial agents and warriors, these sensory devices can detect motion, energy emissions, light outside of Human vision, signs of life, and more. They are generally easy to use and invaluable when scouting unfamiliar terrain.

Using an Auspex or Scanner as an Action reveals energy, life signs, movement, and other data within Medium Range, potentially revealing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#hide]{Hidden} creatures. The GM may call for a Tech Test to detect specific phenomena or overcome interference, with the GM determining the Test Difficulty based on the distance to and strength of the source.

This implant allows its bearer to issue basic orders and commands to suitably configured systems such as cogitator arrays, basic automated industrial equipment and even some Servitors. Similar to the enhanced modules used by Tech-priests to control Skitarii maniples and Kataphron Battle Servitors on the battlefield, a Biomechanical Interface allows an adherent of the machine cult to issue these commands with silent efficiency.

The user gains +1 SL to Tech Tests when operating a machine with a suitable connection, or issuing orders to a suitably equipped cybernetic servant.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Optical: Optical Mechadendrites are usually a metre longer than typical mechadendrites, allowing them to pass through crowded mechanisms and cramped areas to gain visual data. When using the Optical Mechadendrite, you gain +1 SL to Awareness (Sight) Tests and ignore the effects of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#poorly-lit]{Poorly Lit} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#dark]{Dark} Zones due to the integrated @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.1LgXZfag35FhcNoj]{Stablight}. You can also use these to look around corners, over the heads of a thronging crowd, and in many other, inventive ways.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Knowledge and training in a specific subject that is utterly suppressed within the Imperium. Knowing information about aliens or psykers without specific dispensation from a powerful individual or group can get you in serious trouble. True knowledge of daemons lead to summary execution. Any knowledge of the immaterium, beyond common myth, is typically strictly obscured within the Imperium, as is real knowledge about the Adeptus Astartes. Each Forbidden Lore requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

These artificial lungs and filtration-fibres are valued replacements that can repair organs lost due to inhaling smoke, flames, acidic gases, and other dangers (a common occurrence in many manufactorums).

  • You gain +2 SL to Fortitude Tests to resist the effects of airborne toxins and poisonous gases.

Dataslates can be found everywhere in the Imperium and are the most common way to store recorded data of all kinds. They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.

These basic kits are ideal in areas where technology is unreliable or where foul machine spirits dominate and interactions with them is suspect at best. Each has parchment, quills, ink, and other items for recording information to be kept away from prying data sniffers and comm leeches and stored in a manner more permanent than most technologies allow.

Each writing kit contains the necessities for several dozen pages of penmanship, either by hand or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.wazqwH6rG3lKCQUR]{Auto-Quill}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

Training on how to read a crime scene for clues as to what occurred, including inferring whom the parties involved might be, as well as drawing pertinent information from any corpse present. Includes some forensic knowledge, such as knowing how to assess the angle of a strike and the sort of weapons used due to the angle of blood splatters, as well as time since the attack by studying how congealed the gore is.
As an Action, the character can command any Troop of the Adeptus Administratum to immediately take an Action.
The character has advantage whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Rapport}

Well-practised, or specifically trained, to deceive without flinching. Deception is often opposed by Intuition.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

!actors.items!i1LNkpV6WWiZR7PL.EIvsJTRVI.name: Locket containing a few strands of hair and a faded pict showing her former appearance

notes.player:
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Competence at becoming unseen or unremarked by others, such as when camouflaged amidst xenofoliage or tailing someone through a crowd. Hide is usually opposed by an observor's @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jY2q3F8O0ogwpf6E]{Awareness (Sight)}.
Harrog’s flesh and bones are unnaturally malleable, allowing her to squeeze through gaps far too small for someone her size to manage otherwise. She also gains +1 Critical Wound.

This is the standard Imperial communication device, based on especially reliable STC patterns, used across the galaxy for untold centuries. A Vox-Caster allows messages to be sent over long distances, even reaching vessels in low orbit.

A Vox-Caster allows transmission to other Vox-Casters and small units, such as Vox Beads, within 100 miles.

A Holy Icon might take any number of forms depending on an individual's faith and the specific version of the Imperial Creed they follow. For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.
The Sanctifier has 1 point of Fate.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of how to interact with the Machine Spirits that control security devices, along with whatever other systems have been linked to the same, such as doors, thermo-regulators, weapons systems, and so forth, in order to direct them in specific ways. Accomplished through the use of binary codes, modern and ancient, along with various techniques used to sift information from datavaults, secured or otherwise. A Specialisation known to few outside the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}.

A standard tool of many Imperial agents and warriors, these sensory devices can detect motion, energy emissions, light outside of Human vision, signs of life, and more. They are generally easy to use and invaluable when scouting unfamiliar terrain.

Using an Auspex or Scanner as an Action reveals energy, life signs, movement, and other data within Medium Range, potentially revealing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#hide]{Hidden} creatures. The GM may call for a Tech Test to detect specific phenomena or overcome interference, with the GM determining the Test Difficulty based on the distance to and strength of the source.

A Holy Icon might take any number of forms depending on an individual's faith and the specific version of the Imperial Creed they follow. For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of longer firearms, such as lasguns, shotguns, bolters, autoguns, meltaguns, and similar ranged weapons.
Non-Adeptus Mechanicus characters who share a Zone with a Skitarii Vanguard Alpha become Poisoned (Minor). This effect does not stack with other instances of the Rad-saturation Trait.
The Skitarii Vanguard Alpha is always ready for action; their Initiative is increased by 10.
Skitarii Vanguard Alpha can ignore the Dark or Poorly Lit Environmental Traits in their Zone and adjacent Zones.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

Training on how to read a crime scene for clues as to what occurred, including inferring whom the parties involved might be, as well as drawing pertinent information from any corpse present. Includes some forensic knowledge, such as knowing how to assess the angle of a strike and the sort of weapons used due to the angle of blood splatters, as well as time since the attack by studying how congealed the gore is.
The Gang Leader has +1 Resolve and Advantage on Discipline, Presence, Navigation, and Stealth Tests if it is in its own Gang's territory.

Rebreathers employ small air tanks as well as recycling systems so that the user can breathe normally for some time in toxic atmospheres and even underwater.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.

A Laud Hailer greatly amplifies a person's voice such that they can be heard above crowds of chanting pilgrims, screaming cultists, and hive firefights. They are favourite items for preachers, Enforcers, and others who insist on being heard no matter the situation.

When using a Laud Hailer, your voice or other sounds you play or generate can be easily heard up to 100 metres away.

Fire bombs are ancient explosives, dating back to the unknowable past when Humans first discovered that certain liquids were flammable. Promethium or other exotic substances are placed in fragile containers, fitted with burning cloth or electronic igniters, and hurled. The container bursts on impact, spreading flaming liquid across a wide area. Due to their ease of construction, crude bombs are found on almost all Imperial worlds, and the flames they spread are often the first signs of an uprising.

You can make a Ranged Attack to target an enemy with a Fire Bomb. The target is set @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze}. Alternatively, you can target a Zone with a Fire Bomb. A Fire Bombs turns a Zone it hits into a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Minor Hazard} for three rounds. This duration can be extended or shortened depending on the amount of flammable material in the Zone, such as arid forests or rain-slicked spires.

These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.

As long as the Gang Leader is not Engaged, they may use an Action to make a Presence Test. If they succeed, a number of Gangers equal to the SL on the Presence Test that can hear the Gang Leader may immediately take an Action.

Cognomens: Soulshackle, The Chains of Duty Undeserved

Your psychic influence overrides a creature's autonomy, subjugating it to your will. Choose a creature within Medium Range. The target must win a Hard (−20) Discipline (Psychic) Test Opposing your Manifest Test or fall under your control until the start of your next turn. While the target is under your control, you dictate its behaviour, including what it does during its turn.

Whenever the target takes Damage and at the end of its turn, it repeats the Opposed Test, ending the power immediately if it wins. Once a Creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour. The target is aware of your attempt to control them whether you win or lose the first Opposed Test.

Cognomens: The Cleansing of Flesh, Awaken

You pour Psychic power through a creature's body to purge it of harmful disease vectors and restore healthy function. Touch a creature within Immediate Range. If the target is Poisoned or Stunned, those Conditions end. If the target is afflicted with a disease, it adds the SL from your Manifest Test to its next Test to resist it.

Cognomens: Mercurial Suspension, Arcane Lofting

You free yourself from gravity's constraints, floating weightlessly. Until the start of your next turn, you float suspended in space. While floating, you can move at Slow Speed in any direction, ignoring Difficult Terrain.

Alternatively, you can touch an object within Immediate Range and reduce its Encumbrance by 1 per SL until the start of your next turn.

Specialisation in Telekinesis applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Phlebotomise, Bloodwrath

You force a surge of psychic power through your victim, rupturing blood vessels and re-opening scars to cause bleeding throughout their body. Choose a creature within Short Range. The target must win a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Endurance) Test Opposing your Manifest Test or suffer 2 Damage, ignoring Armour, and begin Bleeding (Major). The bleeding continues until it's stopped through medicae treatment or other means.

Cognomens: Steel Skin, Eldritch Endurance

You rapidly modify a creature's flesh with psychic directives, thickening its skin, increasing the density of its flesh, and fortifying its bones while increasing its bulk. Touch a creature (including yourself) within Immediate Range. Until the start of your next turn, the target gains an amount of Armour equal to its Toughness Bonus to all hit locations.

If the creature's Toughness Bonus is greater than its Strength Bonus, the target's Speed decreases by one step (minimum Slow), and the target makes Agility Tests with Disadvantage.

The target can use an Action to make a Challenging (+20) Fortitude (Endurance) Test Opposing your Manifest Test, ending this power immediately if it wins.

This is the standard Imperial communication device, based on especially reliable STC patterns, used across the galaxy for untold centuries. A Vox-Caster allows messages to be sent over long distances, even reaching vessels in low orbit.

A Vox-Caster allows transmission to other Vox-Casters and small units, such as Vox Beads, within 100 miles.

Dataslates can be found everywhere in the Imperium and are the most common way to store recorded data of all kinds. They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.

Cognomens: Emypric Blinding, Grandfather's Curse

You psychically wreak havoc with a creature's biology to hinder and debilitate them. Choose a creature within Short Range. The target must win a Difficult (−10) Fortitude (Endurance) Test Opposing your Manifest Test or gain one of the following conditions until the start of your next turn: Blinded, Deafened, Fatigued, Poisoned, or Stunned. At the end of the target's turn, it makes another Difficult (−10) Fortitude (Endurance) Test Opposing your Manifest Test, ending the power immediately if it wins. Once a creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour.

Cognomens: Endure Mortification, Numbflesh

You disrupt a creature's nociceptors, dulling its sensitivity to pain. Choose a number of creatures (including yourself) up to the SL of your Manifest Test within Short Range. Until the start of your next turn, the target feels no pain, and gains one point of Armour to all hit locations.

Specialisation in Biomancy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: The Truth Unvarnished, The Fourfold Fear

You turn an eldritch key to unlock your target's deepest fears, confronting them with the most nightmarish recesses of their mind. Choose a creature within Medium Range. The target must win on a Hard (−20) Discipline (Fear) Test Opposing your Manifest Test or become Terrified until the start of your next turn. Only the target can see the illusory source of their fear, and it appears within Immediate Range of the target at all times, even when the target moves. At the end of its turn, the target repeats the Opposed Test, ending the power immediately if it wins. Once a Creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for one hour.

Cognomens: The Unfair Trade, The Withering

Attuned to the rhythms of life, you form a psychic link to another creature's body, latching onto it like a parasite syphoning its vitality. Choose a creature within Medium Range. The target must win a Very Hard (−30) Fortitude (Endurance) Test Opposing your Manifest Test or become linked to you until the start of your next turn.

While linked, you can use a Free Action once on your turn to deal Damage equal to your 3 + your Willpower Bonus to the target, which ignores Armour. When this power deals Damage, you heal a number of Wounds equal to half the Damage dealt (rounding up).

At the end of the target's turn, it repeats the Opposed Test, ending the power immediately if it wins. Once a target wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour.

Cognomens: Lifesense, The All Seeing Eye

Souls burn like flames in the darkness of the Warp, and you can attune your senses to detect them. Until the start of your next turn, you can sense the presence of living creatures within Medium Range according to the Soulsight Table. You can exclude specific creatures, such as you and your allies, from what this power detects. Additionally, you have Advantage to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lBzdm76EnuuoGfMq]{Psyniscience} Tests to detect or identify daemons or psykers while this power is active.

Specialisation in Divination applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Soulsight Table

SL

You know... (cumulative)

+1

How many sentient creatures are within range.

+2

The species of each sentient creature within range.

+3

How many sentient creatures are in each Zone within range.

+4

The exact location of each sentient creature within range.

Cognomens: Fleshmould, Abhorrent Alterations

Psychic manipulation of flesh allows you to sculpt a creature's body and features as you envision them. Touch a creature within Immediate Range. Over the course of 10 minutes, you psychically manipulate the target's anatomy and appearance, permanently changing them according to the Shape Flesh Table. If the target is unwilling, it opposes your attempt with an Easy (+40) Fortitude (Endurance) Test. Willing or not, the more substantial the alterations you make, the more pain the target experiences, leaving them @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} for [[/r 1d5]] rounds.

If alterations from this power deliberately mimic the appearance of another specific creature, it can be used as part of a disguise to impersonate that creature. In that case, the Difficulty of Tests to detect the disguise is modified by −10 per SL of your Manifest Test.

Shape Flesh Table

SL

You can... (cumulative)

+1 — +2

Alter minor cosmetic features such as hair/eye/skin colour, facial features, or blemishes.

+3 — +4

Moderately alter height, weight, natural posture, and physique.

+5 or more

Drastically alter features and body structure. This includes rebuilding, removing, or disabling body parts such as limbs and sensory organs. You can cause or repair one @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#injuries]{Injury or Amputation}.

Cognomens: Divine Ministration, Fleshstitch, Succor

You perceive the biomantic energy in a creature's body, bolstering it with your psychic power to speed the restoration of damaged tissue. Touch a creature (including yourself) within Immediate Range. The target heals Wounds equal to your Willpower Bonus + the target's Toughness Bonus + the SL from your Manifest Test, and if the target is Bleeding, the Condition is removed. The influx of biomantic energy from this power taxes the target's body, so if it receives the benefit of this power again before it Rests, it becomes Fatigued.

Specialisation in Biomancy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Blast, Empyric Screech, Eldritch Undoing

You unleash a corruscating blast of raw psychic power against a foe, rending flesh and spirit. Choose a Creature within Medium Range. The target suffers Damage equal to 2 + your Willpower Bonus + the SL from your Manifest Test, which ignores Armour.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.
Characters affected by Sihn’s Cleanse or Seal Wounds Psychic Powers must make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Endurance) Test to resist gaining 1 point of Corruption.

Cognomens: Death's Visage, The Emperor's Gaze, Unsettle

You invoke the Warp's terrifying nature to exude a dreadful presence, inciting irrational fear in enemies near you. Until the start of your next turn, the first time an enemy enters your Zone in a round or starts its turn there, it must win a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Fear) Test Opposed by your Manifest Test or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. If a creature wins the Opposed Test, it is immune to this power for the next hour.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

Cognomens: Irresistible Command, The Emperor's Voice

You issue a simple psychic command to your victim, compelling them to obey against their will. Choose a creature within Short Range. The target must make a Routine (+20) Discipline (Psychic) Test Opposing your Manifest Test. If you win, you immediately declare one Action or Movement the target will take on its next turn, and the target must carry it out before it does anything else. Whether you win or lose the Opposed Test, the target is aware that you compelled them.
Sihn can choose to gain Advantage on any Psychic Mastery Test. If he does so, he must double the Warp Charge gained.

These devices convert energy from an attack into a powerful burst of light, and for that reason are also called 'flare fields'. In the Macharian Sector, honoured members of the Ecclesiarchy are sometimes bestowed a variant known as a rosarius, some of which date back to the preachers who first accompanied the Lord Solar in bringing the Emperor's light to untamed worlds during the conquest of the Macharian Sector.

If a Conversion Field reduces 10 or more Damage from a single attack, it erupts in brilliant light, inflicting the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#blinded]{Blinded} Condition on all creatures in the Zone for one round. This renders any attempt at stealth a failure, but does not otherwise affect the user.

Cognomens: Handscald, Emblaze

You channel psychic energy into an object until it glows with searing heat. Choose an object with an Encumbrance no greater than the SL of your Manifest Test within Medium Range. Until the start of your next turn, the object becomes burning hot and glows dimly. A creature touching the object when you manifest this power suffers Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, and suffers the Damage again at the end of its turn if it's still touching the object. If the object is a piece of Armour a creature is wearing, its Armour Value does not reduce the Damage. When the power ends, the heated object cools at a normal rate. At the GM's discretion, materials that can withstand the heat may become somewhat malleable while heated, while less robust materials may simply melt.

Specialisation in Pyromancy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

When a non-sanctioned psyker within Medium Range of Agorax Manifests a power, Agorax may use his Reaction to make an immediate @UUID[.zwmTchhxfQXGWDzn]{Heavy Flamer} attack on the zone that psyker is in.
Agorax has +10 to Strength and Toughness but −10 to Intelligence and Fellowship.
Agorax has 1 point of Fate.

For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

If in earshot of Kragon’s Flask, Kragon can call for backup once per encounter. Backup usually arrives in [[/br 1d5 # Rounds]] Rounds and consists of a mix of loyal @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.ZUWBWGM4eH7xFZ8P]{Dregs} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.bB0rMr6Gez3M9bME]{Gangers}.
When an ally in the Flask fails a Test and can see Kragon, Kragon can use his Reaction to allow the ally to reroll the failed Test.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.

They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.

Disguise Kits are filled with makeup sets, facial prosthetics, skin and hair dyes, wigs and facial hair appliances, and more. A Disguise Kit is essential when merely altering your voice and clothing isn't enough to fool guards and pict scanners. It takes 10 minutes to alter your appearance using a Disguise Kit. No Test is required to simply make yourself look different. However, if you are trying to alter your appearance to appear as a member of a particular faction or to impersonate a specific individual, the GM can ask for a Challenging (+0) or harder Dexterity Test.
Intuition Tests targeting the Smuggler are made with Disadvantage.

A valuable device when exploring frontier wilderness, crumbling hivescapes, and other areas lacking directional features, a Multicompass employs a variety of sensors and gyroscopic cogitators to signal axial and magnetic north on a planet.

You can use a Multicompass in combination with Navigation (Surface) or other Tests relating to making your way across unfamiliar terrain.

A Chrono is a basic, though often overlooked, item used to determine the time. Resourceful folk use Chronos to synchronise their actions.

Chronos display the current time and, if the planet supports it, automatically adjust to local time after only a few seconds on the ground.
The Smuggler has +1 Resolve when in conversation.

Designed to fit inside the user's ear, these communication tools let someone effortlessly talk to and hear others on the same vox channel. As their range is far beyond shouting, and work in situations where shouting would call dangerous attention, they are almost essential for mission outfitting.

This item allows the wearer to communicate with other users on the same channel within a mile, though dense metallic obstructions and violent weather can lessen or disrupt the ability.

Signal Jammers overload airborne electronic transmissions such as vox messages and data feeds, completely severing the connection. There is usually no attempt at subtlety and everyone with access to the transmissions can tell something is interfering, but if simple ceasing of communication is the goal, then Signal Jammers do the job quite well.

You can activate the Signal Jammer as a Free Action. While active, the Signal Jammer disrupts vox and data transmissions within 1 mile. If not connected to a power source, a jammer can operate for 2 hours before its battery is depleted.

Refractor Fields emit a soft glow and crackle while active, a sure sign that the user has far more than the Emperor's protection to ward them from harm. While often a glorious radiance, the light is detrimental to most covert activities.

While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.

A standard tool of many Imperial agents and warriors, these sensory devices can detect motion, energy emissions, light outside of Human vision, signs of life, and more. They are generally easy to use and invaluable when scouting unfamiliar terrain.

Using an Auspex or Scanner as an Action reveals energy, life signs, movement, and other data within Medium Range, potentially revealing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#hide]{Hidden} creatures. The GM may call for a Tech Test to detect specific phenomena or overcome interference, with the GM determining the Test Difficulty based on the distance to and strength of the source.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Practised at resisting charm, intimidation, and other social pressures. Those with strong Composure are gifted at maintaining their integrity in the face of temptation.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

The ability to assess relative worth based on perceived qualities. Useful for determining the value of practical goods and equipment, or the soundness of a given structure or device.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

Kesker knows he hasn’t long left to live and has nothing to lose now but a few agonising days. If he can help his fellow labourers or hurt Lord Felputh, he’ll summon one last burst of strength to do it. If motivated, his Characteristic and Skill values can be doubled for one round, after which he succumbs to the extent of his Bloodlung and dies.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

The immaterium lies just behind reality, outside the perception of most creatures in the galaxy, but you are not most creatures. As a psyker, you are aware of the warp, though you may not understand it. You can access and unleash its tumultuous power into realspace.

Channelling such power is fraught with perils, however, and death is far from the most frightening possibility one might face. When you acquire this Talent, you gain the ability to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev]{manifest Psychic Powers}. You can also purchase Advances in the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#psychic-mastery-(wil)]{Psychic Mastery} Skill and the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lBzdm76EnuuoGfMq]{Awareness (Psyniscience)} Specialisation.

When you gain this Talent, you learn one @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.xoUemA7abdmB6DJ1#minor-psychic-powers]{Minor Psychic Power}. Additionally, select a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.V5zDWussZivkFavj]{Psychic Discipline} and immediately gain one power of your choice from that discipline. You can spend 60 XP to purchase additional Minor Psychic Powers or 100 XP to purchase Psychic Powers from your chosen Discipline.

You can purchase this Talent a number of times up to your Willpower Bonus. Each additional time you purchase this Talent, you access a new Psychic Discipline and one power of that Discipline.

requirement.value: Cannot have the Blank Talent. This applies even during Character Creation

notes.player:
A Holy Icon might take any number of forms depending on an individual's faith and the specific version of the Imperial Creed they follow. For many it is a small Aquila, perhaps hand-made or gained during a pilgrimage to a sacred location. Icons carved from the ground upon which Saint Macharius trod are popular as well.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.
The Heldrax’s Stalker has Advantage on Stealth Tests if they do not move that turn.

Popular among assassins and other fighters who need to pierce armour with ease, Mono-edges are molecule-thin superfine blades that never dull.

A Mono-edge can be applied to any Mundane bladed melee weapon, granting it the Penetrating (2) Trait, or increasing its Penetrating rating by 2 if it already has the Trait. At the GM's discretion, they may allow other Mundane weapons to use this modification. In this case, the modification takes the form of a powerful pneumatic spike or kill-plate.

Rebreathers employ small air tanks as well as recycling systems so that the user can breathe normally for some time in toxic atmospheres and even underwater.

While using a rebreather, you ignore penalties due to poisonous, deadly, and otherwise unhealthy air, and can breathe underwater. Rebreather tanks last for an hour before they need to be replaced as an Action. Additional tanks cost 20 solars. A set of two spare tanks are 1 Encumbrance.

The choice of garb for snipers and thieves alike, this cloak covers the entire body and uses exotic mimic fibres that automatically shift colouration to match the surroundings. If you do not move during your turn while wearing a Cameleoline Cloak, you gain +2 SL on Stealth Tests until you move or make a loud noise.
A Heldrax’s Stalker can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of their Movement if the Zone they are in has Cover.

This is the standard Imperial communication device, based on especially reliable STC patterns, used across the galaxy for untold centuries. A Vox-Caster allows messages to be sent over long distances, even reaching vessels in low orbit.

A Vox-Caster allows transmission to other Vox-Casters and small units, such as Vox Beads, within 100 miles.

A standard tool of many Imperial agents and warriors, these sensory devices can detect motion, energy emissions, light outside of Human vision, signs of life, and more. They are generally easy to use and invaluable when scouting unfamiliar terrain.

Using an Auspex or Scanner as an Action reveals energy, life signs, movement, and other data within Medium Range, potentially revealing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#hide]{Hidden} creatures. The GM may call for a Tech Test to detect specific phenomena or overcome interference, with the GM determining the Test Difficulty based on the distance to and strength of the source.

Dataslates can be found everywhere in the Imperium and are the most common way to store recorded data of all kinds. They can be used to interface with many machines by making a Routine (+20) Tech Test, though obscure or well-protected machinery might require a more difficult Test, or may simply lack the necessary interfaces entirely.

A Dataslate can store and display multiple text data, picts, and vid files. Each can be locked with a biometric password, requiring a Hard (−20) Tech Test to bypass.
Lieutenant Cole has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.

Krak grenades and missiles are found throughout the Imperium war machine. They are designed for armour penetration and overwhelm most personal protective gear with ease. Krak rounds also excel at blowing apart bulkheads, vehicle hulls, and fortifications, leaving those inside exposed and vulnerable.

Krak munitions have high damage and the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait, but a limited radius.
Lieutenant Cole has Advantage on Tech Tests when operating his Vox caster or any standard piece of Astra Militarum equipment.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
When a Beastman makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.
When a Beastman Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

A standard tool of many Imperial agents and warriors, these sensory devices can detect motion, energy emissions, light outside of Human vision, signs of life, and more. They are generally easy to use and invaluable when scouting unfamiliar terrain.

Using an Auspex or Scanner as an Action reveals energy, life signs, movement, and other data within Medium Range, potentially revealing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#hide]{Hidden} creatures. The GM may call for a Tech Test to detect specific phenomena or overcome interference, with the GM determining the Test Difficulty based on the distance to and strength of the source.

These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

The Tech-Priest has @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.zK3ii7HUPfnQGKtg]{Augmetic Arms}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.PS24p896oNkNxwc4]{Augmetic Legs}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6VeObvauzrXSw5nO]{Augmetic Heart}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.gMiilnjEIZawYcfG]{Augmetic Respiratory System}, and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organs}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.DN4ZI8z7SqJjsney]{Utility Mechadendrite}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.2SkHTUxjqUxiyW6b]{Optical Mechadendrite}, and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.wRIE5K6YuMtymmm0]{Biomechanical Interface}. The benefits of these Augmetics are already included.
Can access cramped areas to give visual data and includes a stablight which can remove the Dark Environmental Trait from a Zone.
The Tech-Priest gains +1 SL to Tech Tests for operating a machine with a suitable connection, such as many vehicles, environmental processors, and manufactorum assemblers.

As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
The Tech-Priest gains +2 SL to Fortitude Tests to resist the effects of airborne toxins and poisonous gases.
These items feature a plethora of probes, blades, socket plugs, cleaning hooks, and other aids to appease stubborn Machine Spirits and awakening slumbering ones to service.
Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.
Dorin is an expert at covering his tracks. Any Tests made to find or retrieve information from his dataslate or computer terminals are increased to Hard (−20) Difficulty.

These items allow you to transcribe spoken words or copy written ones onto parchment. Auto-Quills work through an impossibly complex system of brass mechanisms, ink generators, and vat-grown quills, all with a great exactitude and faster than even a literate scribe.

While you have an Auto-Quill on your person, you can use it to dictate and transcribe spoken word onto parchment, or copy written text and diagrams onto fresh parchment.
Dorin can use his action to command a member of the Court of Sihn within Medium range to make an immediate action.

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

The Administratum Adept has a Resolve of 3 whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.
The Administratum Adept has Advantage on Tests made to find or retrieve information from a document or archive (whether analog or digital).
Skitarii Vanguard Alpha can ignore the Dark or Poorly Lit Environmental Traits in their Zone and adjacent Zones.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of how to interact with the Machine Spirits that control security devices, along with whatever other systems have been linked to the same, such as doors, thermo-regulators, weapons systems, and so forth, in order to direct them in specific ways. Accomplished through the use of binary codes, modern and ancient, along with various techniques used to sift information from datavaults, secured or otherwise. A Specialisation known to few outside the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}.
Non-Adeptus Mechanicus characters who share a Zone with a Skitarii Vanguard Alpha become Poisoned (Minor). This effect does not stack with other instances of the Rad-saturation Trait.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of longer firearms, such as lasguns, shotguns, bolters, autoguns, meltaguns, and similar ranged weapons.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Rapport}

Trained, or naturally skilled, at getting answers out of others via gossip, friendly conversation, or pointed questions. Inquiry can be opposed by either @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.i5ycJHAR6vodK1sM]{Presence (Intimidation)}.

A character with a Holy Icon who has shown sufficient faith may add +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

Aptitude in a variety of techniques designed to elicit answers out of a subject. A skilled interrogator implies pressure in many ways, subtle and not, in order to discover as much information as they can, even when a subject is cooperative. Interrogation is not physical torture, though undergoing a long interrogation may certainly feel agonising. Interrogation is opposed by the target's @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Endurance (Pain)}.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Advanced capacity for perceiving important details and training in noticing elements that seem even a little incongruous.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

The Skitarii Vanguard Alpha is constantly fed data from their Skitarii masters. While connected, the Alpha’s Resolve cannot deplete, they cannot become Desperate, and they have Advantage on all Willpower Tests.
The Skitarii Vanguard Alpha is always ready for action; their Initiative is increased by 10.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

Training on how to read a crime scene for clues as to what occurred, including inferring whom the parties involved might be, as well as drawing pertinent information from any corpse present. Includes some forensic knowledge, such as knowing how to assess the angle of a strike and the sort of weapons used due to the angle of blood splatters, as well as time since the attack by studying how congealed the gore is.

Perhaps the most widely used Imperial military-grade munitions, Frag munitions are most commonly found in grenade and missile form. Both explode in showers of shrapnel and other lacertaing metals, making them ideal for anti-infantry duties. Almost every warrior in the Imperium, from Militarum troopers to elite Space Marines, carries frag grenades to aid in assaulting positions, with grenade launchers providing longer range infantry suppression. Frag missiles are the more powerful version, with a greater range to soften up distant positions such as heavy weapon teams.

Frag grenades have a large radius, and deal decent damage.
The Commissar has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.

@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Mentally hardened to stand firm in the face of the unnatural fear caused by exposure to heretical and corrupt beings. Fear is often used to resist and recover from the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.

Survival Gear encompasses a wide range of equipment designed for long durations in wilderness areas, including the crumbling habways of destroyed cities and other areas where basic necessities are unavailable. Though bulky, they can mean the difference between life and death in areas where no one might ever find the remains.

Each Survival Gear pack includes items such as a bedroll, insulated tent, canteen, rope, firestarters, candles, hydro-purifier tabs, and other basics except for actual food and water. Survival Gear can be used in combination with Fortitude (Endurance) to endure @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#exposure]{Exposure}.

A basic item for operating for extended durations in toxic atmospheres, respirators and gas masks cover the majority of the face and offer much greater protection than @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.OdTP4DEK3oGAjMWZ]{Filtration Plugs}, at the cost of being bulky and obscuring the senses.

While wearing a Respirator, you automatically pass any Tests to resist the effects of airborne pathogens but suffer Disadvantage on Awareness (Sight) Tests.

Most types are compact and can fold to a size that can be stowed away when marching or fighting.

An Entrenching Tool can also be used as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lwPymw5Hah0H8Ey5]{Improvised (One-handed)} melee weapon. A properly sharpened Entrenching Tool counts as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.cnbaSByME7caQohv]{Axe} instead.
