Vertexis Cultist

@Embed[Compendium.impmal-voll.actors.Actor.BNzIELnXHo5A5LGP description=top table=true style=width:70%;margin:auto;]

Implacable takes place throughout the Lower Hive sectors of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.8lJW1E95hsf5Hu4K.JournalEntryPage.yspwSIQuXjVjk3NA#hive-rokarth]{Hive Rokarth}, drawing characters into a plot of widespread murder and heretical cult activity, masterminded by an unlikely and deadly foe. Implacable can serve as a stand-alone experience played over 2–3 sessions or, should they survive, as part of a extensive campaign.

primary.name: Crude Rejuvenat Effect
primary.description: Note: Characters sprayed with the crude rejuvenat chemicals should roll on this Table. Anyone unfortunate enough to be submerged entirely in one of the vats or entirely doused in the chemical adds +5 to their d10 roll.

primary.name: Voll Adventure Rumours
primary.description: Note: Each section lists a rumour that characters could hear in the Upper Hive or Lower Hive of Rokarth, and what each rumour generally means to the class of people living there.

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.M4PXMqI.description: A patrol of @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastmen} (equal to the number of characters), led by a @UUID[Actor.TRcwwntLPqt7KaJy]{Mutated Beastman} patrols the upper refinery checking for any trouble. Their route brings them back to the @UUID[JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd.JournalEntryPage.vvoa9Cf947QMkVH8#1e.-northern-tunnel-entrance]{Northern Tunnels Entrance (1E)}. If the patrol detects the party, it attacks at once.

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.UN4Gv1u.description: A patrol of @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastmen} (an amount equal to the number of characters), escorts a bound and wounded woman through a refinery. This is Ness, an escapee from @UUID[JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd.JournalEntryPage.vvoa9Cf947QMkVH8#1b.-the-pens]{The Pens (1B)} (use the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourer} stat-block to represent her). If the characters free her and point her to an exit, she is lucky enough to find her way out of the refinery and survive. If the characters instead choose to follow the Beastmen, this takes them to The Pens (1B).

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.YihIsln.description: Shouts and snorts alert the players to a pair of Beastmen arguing. These are brothers, Frisk and Targ, at odds because one wants to rescue their old leader, @UUID[Actor.YWOtDHG1vScQKCB4]{Mesk}, while the other is devoted to the new leader, the @UUID[Actor.FS6l4jv4KbzBf89s]{Shaman}. If the argument plays out without interference from the characters, the brothers fight and Frisk dies. If the characters help Frisk, he could become an ally, but only if the characters promise to help free Mesk.

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.fkYl429.description: A rattling, scrabbling noise alerts the party to the presence of a pair of scavengers, picking meat off a charred carcass. These are Humans who were desperate enough to sneak in through the tunnels to find something to eat (use the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.ZUWBWGM4eH7xFZ8P]{Dreg} stat-block to represent them). On closer inspection, the carcass they are picking over appears Humanoid, some unfortunate victim of @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastmen} who was cooked and eaten. The scavengers don’t care about the nature of the meat, but flee if alerted to the presence of Beastmen.

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.jDyvekW.description: A putrid smell emanates from a rounded, upturned lid taken from some vat to serve as a cooking pot. A makeshift stand has been made from scraps of metal and broken cogs, suspending the lid over a still-smouldering fire. The contents of the ‘pot’ are thick and black. Anyone close enough to smell the concoction gains 1 Corruption. Touching it means gaining 2 Corruption. If anyone is foolish enough to taste it, they gain 4 Corruption and double their Strength for the remainder of the adventure.

!tables.results!10m912eLDoBpYITR.jyzTeGx.description: A wounded @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastman} has dragged himself into a dark corner between storage vats to die in peace. Attacked by his herd for remaining loyal to @UUID[Actor.YWOtDHG1vScQKCB4]{Mesk}, he can only hope his herd’s own corruption destroys them. If the characters try to help him in any way, he gifts them the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.items.Item.tqGb4ULjvQP5x7AK]{cleaver} that an attacker left buried in his side. It’s all he has. Once the cleaver has been removed, the Beastman quickly bleeds out.

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.0jxL2aM.description: ‘Overhead you see large pipes buckle and bend, screws and fastenings snap as something shifts and writhes inside.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.3voqGpo.description: ‘You see the shadows on the wall melt together to form something vast and terrible, you feel it watching you.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.Fylj7dA.description: ‘Your arm quivers and you see the veins beneath your skin wriggle like swarming worms.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.IGrcUwg.description: ‘In your peripheral vision, dark figures watch you; they vanish as you look directly at them.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.PqdF7R8.description: ‘The face of the companion closest to you melts into a mess of weeping slime and sharp, glistening mandibles.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.XDo9CqE.description: ‘Around a corner, you see an expanse of acidic wasteland where hundreds of hooded figures gather in strange ruins.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.ZMmhKsQ.description: ‘As an ally speaks to you, you notice several tiny acynadi-like creatures scuttling in and out of their mouth.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.mLGuWJQ.description: ‘In a puddle, you see your reflection looking back at you, it grins widely from ear to ear.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.nHdDFSS.description: ‘You feel something brush your leg and look down to see the flesh bubble away as if dissolved, sloughing off to slap wetly on the floor.’

!tables.results!Gl7QDuzJmGGFTiLg.pYz795r.description: ‘A horrific monstrosity, half Human and half acynadi seizes you by the throat as it shrieks.’

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.FnvNZGA.name: Minor Spray
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.FnvNZGA.description: A spray of caustic chemicals splashes across a random hit location, leaving a nasty burn if that location is unarmoured.

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.Guh3O78.name: Horrific Mutation
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.Guh3O78.description: You suffer a hideous mutation! At the end of the encounter, roll on the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.tables.RollTable.aHz4wSCM8ogTVOhT]{Mutations Table}.

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.YiZ4jeC.name: Deep Burns
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.YiZ4jeC.description: A spray of especially caustic chemicals splashes across a random hit location, destroying up to 5 points of armour on that location. If the location is unarmoured, then flesh is stripped to the bone, inflicting [[/r 1d10]] Damage on that location instead. If the location was a limb, any Test which involves the use of that limb suffers from Disadvantage until a Challenging (+0) Medicae (Human) Test is made to treat the wound.

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.vThEl0T.name: Caustic Spray
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.vThEl0T.description: A spray of especially caustic chemicals splashes across a random hit location, destroying up to 3 points of armour on that location. If the hit location is unarmoured, then flesh is stripped to the bone, inflicting [[/r 1d10]] Damage on that location instead.

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.xlVa83q.name: Partial Rejuvenation
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.xlVa83q.description: This particular mix of Rejuvenat seems to have some effect. At the end of the encounter, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.gLYbTQPGuxwSPURo]{Inhuman Beauty} Mutation.

!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.z19yHah.name: Significant Exposure
!tables.results!HPlvqxmfzkHy3gUG.z19yHah.description: The Rejuvenat precursors inflict a gradual detrimental effect on your tissue, adding [[/r 2d10]] to your apparent age over the next week.

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.6MFq3Tp.description: Manufactorum 74-c15 has been shut down. People say it was rioting workers, but I know the truth: it was Ork raiders! [False, the workers shut down the manufactorum. @UUID[Actor.siMMykRHCMATkA9u]{Rastigan Dorin}, the sub-prefect, is spreading this rumour until he can get the situation under control and the manufactorum producing once more.]

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.8ka1YyZ.description: Sihn is, in fact, a xenos entity that has come to punish local citizens of the Imperium. Some more informed characters may press the point that he’s an Aeldari wych. [False, on both accounts.]

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.90GaDBI.description: A group of mercenaries were just asking about Sihn. I didn’t get too good a look at them but… (You should pick one of the other hunting teams and describe someone memorable among them.) [True.]

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.ZWYrc1n.description: In region Gamma-74, a Stilt-fleet walker was attacked by a massive beast; Markis Sihn called the beast out of the wastes with his strange powers. [Partially true. A walker was attacked, but it was by marauders, not by a beast. Rumours about a beast was started by @UUID[Actor.siMMykRHCMATkA9u]{Rastigan Dorin}.]

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.dAJAVpO.description: The workers in the acid refineries, processing plants, and crawlers of Gamma-74 have had enough. They are sick and tired of being sick and tired. Sihn showed them there is another way. That they do not have to waste their lives for others. [Partially true. Sihn inspired the workers to join his cult but wanted nothing to do with any rebellion.]

!tables.results!MPIbOaHVIrt42md2.lCKNsxe.description: Markis Sihn is a saviour to the people. He heals citizens who become sick from the chemical manufactorum’s by-products in the region, and he asks little in return. [True, discounting the fact that those he heals are also transformed.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.M4PXMqI.description: There’s something monstrous lurking in the tunnels and pipes around the refinery. You can hear its strange banging against the metal as it prowls. A grotesque acynadi? A powerful mutant? No one knows what it is, but all fear it. [True.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.UN4Gv1u.description: Someone’s heard that @UUID[Actor.BMt1lzDVRMWAsuQk]{Lord Felputh} cancelled orders of rejuvenat and a whole new wardrobe from House Parnham. If his wealth has run out, it would explain why he let his workers go. He can’t pay them! [Half-True — wealth is relative, so while the nobleman has had to forego a few luxuries, he still has more solars than his labourers could ever hope to earn.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.YihIsln.description: One night, locals in the hab units around the refinery were told to keep well away from the facility due to a pipeline leak. Yet someone heard animals braying and swore they saw men with fur and hooves being marched towards it. [True — this was the secret arrival of the new workers for the refinery.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.fkYl429.description: Several locals know someone who’s disappeared recently, and they fear that someone or something’s snatching people and dragging them off to the refinery. [True.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.jDyvekW.description: A Chaos cult took hold among some of the desperate refinery workers, and it’s their fault so many are stricken with Bloodlung. Even now, some remain hidden in the refinery, conducting obscene rituals. [Half-True — Bloodlung was rife before any Chaos rituals took place in the refinery.]

!tables.results!No9sZ8JS0BvcygHQ.jyzTeGx.description: The plague of Bloodlung isn’t an accident. The lord has been experimenting with toxic agents, looking for ways to take down his rivals and strengthen his own position as a noble. [False.]

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.8vXVeP4.description: Don’t go outside without a rebreather or some filtration plugs; the acid in the air will eat through your lungs from the first breath.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.BtsRt3R.description: The Macharian Vigilites patrol the hives, but they rarely investigate the hive sprawl and never go out into the wastes or far-flung outposts. Their primary concern is to make sure Imperial society is maintained and protected, best done around the hive’s core and above.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.IHnuKP3.description: Never eat uncured acynadi meat; the tinned stuff is fine, but if it’s unprocessed, you’ll be emptying your bowels for days, and you might not have any bowels left afterwards.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.IdLIE1k.description: I heard massive beasts are lurking in the world’s wastes, some as big as an Imperial Knight. You won’t see them until they surface and strike.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.OnTwC8Q.description: The highborn symbolically scar their flesh off the acid rain by stepping out bare-headed onto their balconies when it’s raining. Some do it as a cleansing ritual, but others see it as a mark of privilege and status, a gift from living atop uncovered towers.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.QoP1xrD.description: Walkers are the best means to travel across Voll’s uneven wastes. Any boat would get its hull eaten through in a couple of days, and you don’t want to sink into a swamp that’ll eat your skin off.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.ZM8PofE.description: They wash the mid levels of their hives with the same acid they harvest; artificial rain to keep it all clean. Keep an eye on the Adeptus Administratum’s cleansing procedures to avoid getting burned.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.bc8lFli.description: Gangs are everywhere, but it’s the guilds you’ve got to keep your eyes on. The Mercator Carnem, Mercator Dilaquo, and Mercator Lenimen — food, water, and chems, respectively. A ganger might take your life, but the guilds can make your life not worth living.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.nRdUAO9.description: Don’t get caught doing anything you shouldn’t near Hive Sanksorak, or mess too much with House Vylathi — they’ll take any reason to bolster their penal legion.

!tables.results!PVBIdihw9kMQmw2M.s5C1tfd.description: Make sure you’ve got paperwork for your weapons if you’re going into the Upper Hives. The Vigilites are always looking for an excuse to lock people up.

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.M4PXMqI.description: A group of @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastmen} (a number equal to party size) led by a @UUID[Actor.TRcwwntLPqt7KaJy]{Mutated Beastman} carrying a flaming torch patrols the tunnels. They are looking for intruders, and if any of the Beastmen detect the party, the entire patrol attacks at once.

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.UN4Gv1u.description: A Human captive hangs from a rope in a dead-end tunnel. They’re still alive, kicking and cursing, trying to get free. If the characters release them, they attack the party with nothing but their elongated teeth and nails. They’ve already been touched by Chaos, infused with manic strength (use the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourer} stat-block to represent them, but increase their strength by 15 and they have the following attack — Tooth and Nail: Melee (Brawling) 40, 1 + SL difference Damage. Penetrating (4).

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.YihIsln.description: A mutated captive, consumed by rage and madness, roams the tunnels, a victim of the Shaman’s rites (Use the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.utelXH1DahFI5iHt]{Accursed Cultist} stat-block to represent them).

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.fkYl429.description: @UUID[Actor.J8fomG1IJs18g3F5]{Gelka} steps into the party’s path, brandishing twin hammers, and challenges the characters, seeking to discover their intentions. She intends to kill the Shaman and release her herd from his influence — the characters might consider her a potential ally.

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.jDyvekW.description: A partially collapsed tunnel has been turned into a profane shrine. Scraps of flesh and bloodied clothes have been pushed between cracks in broken stones, and marks have been scratched on the walls using blood, ash, or other means. There seems to be no one here, but if the party investigates too closely, a @UUID[Actor.TRcwwntLPqt7KaJy]{Mutated Beastman} surprises them from behind.

!tables.results!jBVqRmfuErptNaGv.jyzTeGx.description: A @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastman} has fallen foul of the ravages of Chaos and become a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.7GvkaaVAd69ORno0]{Chaos Spawn}. This creature bleats and screams as it passes through the tunnels, so the party should be able to avoid its path. It has no eyes, but if it hears them, it pursues relentlessly and attacks.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.IrsrrFE.name: Upper Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.IrsrrFE.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9]{The Eye of Voll}- Industrial action in planetary region Gamma-74 threatens to delay Rokarth’s tithe contributions. Some say this is the work of a mysterious cult leader who seeks to challenge the status quo.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.J141zVx.name: Lower Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.J141zVx.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ]{Interminable Devotion}- Some speak of an ancient Capitol Imperialis rumbling across Voll’s wastes, under the sway of House Nethecaré. To lay your eyes upon this super-heavy tank is a sight to behold.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.P6JxHDS.name: Upper Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.P6JxHDS.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd]{Paradigm Shift}- Sharks are circling one Lord Felputh. He is behind on tithe fulfilments, and has holdings over rejuvenat chemicals crucial to the extended lives of the highborn of Rokarth.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.TZvGduS.name: Lower Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.TZvGduS.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd]{Paradigm Shift}- Another manufactorum up in flames! A few locals in surrounding districts report that some of their friends and family have gone missing.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.egQXxyG.name: Lower Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.egQXxyG.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9]{The Eye of Voll}- There is a healer out in the wastes to the west that can heal any injury. Some believe he is an Imperial Saint, blessed by the God-Emperor.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.fagulrT.name: Upper Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.fagulrT.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ]{Interminable Devotion}- A wayward scion of House Nethecaré has been missing for some time, yet the noble house only became aware of their absence because of the resources this person stole.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.j0AkHjd.name: Upper Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.j0AkHjd.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.yAAIQKv8lK49HRLz]{Implacable}- A wave of murders threatens the Halion’s Triumph celebrations. Whoever is in charge is facing concerns that the hive-wide festivities should be postponed until these murders are solved.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.nuDkYxu.name: Lower Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.nuDkYxu.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.yAAIQKv8lK49HRLz]{Implacable}- A rapidly growing death cult known as the Vertexis is quickly gaining power and popularity. People think they are building towards something sinister, and the clock is ticking.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.qC8SfOS.name: Lower Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.qC8SfOS.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.DSccO5miF7LSJCVS]{Illicit Fabrications}- Citizens are mourning in the wake of Manufactorum Vitus-II’s sudden destruction. Moreover, they’re starting to report sightings of mutants lurking around the area.

!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.qCg9mlH.name: Upper Hive
!tables.results!pvLxM5N4RAtjZJLB.qCg9mlH.description: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-voll.journals.JournalEntry.DSccO5miF7LSJCVS]{Illicit Fabrications}- The Adeptus Mechanicus deem the destruction of a manufactorum in the lower hive unsatisfactory. Its output supplied Rokarth's nobility with key rejuvenat reagents and was an invaluable asset to Mechanicus sovereignty on Voll. The disappearance of the primary Tech-Priest overseer is also deemed sub optimal.

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.0jxL2aM.description: ‘A wet slithering sound, like something smooth wriggling through mud, terminates in an echo of inhuman footsteps.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.3voqGpo.description: ‘Heavy footsteps thunder like heavy cannon fire, slowly drawing closer and closer until they seem all around you.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.Fylj7dA.description: ‘The barking laughter of a dozen voices seems to come from inside a nearby wall.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.IGrcUwg.description: ‘Scratching seems to follow you, like the sound of clawed fingers raking repeatedly across rusted deck plates.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.PqdF7R8.description: ‘A scream cuts through the air raw and blood curdling, echoing out around you in a cacophony of suffering.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.XDo9CqE.description: ‘A loud thumping noise catches your attention from somewhere far off, gradually building faster and faster.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.ZMmhKsQ.description: ‘You hear a whispered voice repeating the same phrase, it takes you a moment to realise it's saying… ‘Soon they’ll know’.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.mLGuWJQ.description: ‘You hear a child’s voice call out to you from a nearby drain, saying ‘Help me’.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.nHdDFSS.description: ‘A faint babbling seems to intermingle with the sound of running water, soon you realise it’s not babbling, it’s weeping.’

!tables.results!w6qJK8mdonMAPkSG.pYz795r.description: ‘A voice calls your name, and each time it repeats, it sounds deeper, wetter, and less human.’

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.6pio4AI.description: The party’s path presents them with a maze of twisting, crumbling habways that wind their way far above hissing pits of industrial effluent. A fall here is potentially fatal. Local guides offer to show the characters the safest path for 20 solars each. Crossing without a guide requires each character to make a Routine (+20) Athletics (Climbing) Test. Failure causes them to slip along the path. Luckily, they fall onto a walkway further below and suffer [[/r 1d10]] Damage from the impact.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.EbD9En5.description: The ever-present smog that casts the hab slums in a hazy yellow light briefly parts, allowing the party to see a patrol of Skitarii Vanguard ahead, about to burst into a squat, ramshackle dwelling. The party may shout a warning to those within, diverting the Skitarii’s attention, or allow events to unfold as they will.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.KsmxSAI.description: A Skitarii patrol blocks the path ahead, dragging citizens aside to question. The party may attempt to endure the repetitive questioning, negotiate their way past, or scale a series of rusty containers to avoid the oncoming patrol. This requires characters to make a Challenging (+0) Athletics (Climbing) Test. Failure alerts the Skitarii patrol, who are now suspicious of the party.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.PcOQ4rP.description: Noxious gases pool like acrid smoke over a pond of greasy water. It’s clear from the ad-hoc collection of pipes and containers that the pool is used as a local water supply. Ignorant and unheeding of the patrols, Agala, an elderly blind woman, uses a hooked pole to drag detritus from the questionable water. Despite her ailment, she can easily direct the characters anywhere in the hab slums. She assumes the slums, especially the ‘lagoon’ she tends, are the most beautiful place in Rokarth.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.Zdnbv4e.description: The characters stumble upon a code-locked Skitarii dataslate lying in the mud. A successful Hard (−20) Tech (Security) Test can unlock the dataslate, as can the data interface of any @UUID[Actor.vsiOALilPnEe3dKg]{Skitarri Vanguard Alpha}. The dataslate contains what the Skitarii know about the missing Tech-Priest, including the fact that intermittent transmissions from their implanted life-auger indicate they are still alive and somewhere in this sector of the Lower Hive.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.gYx3n40.description: Four @UUID[Actor.jSJkugzVGrfqbl9o]{Skitarii Vanguard} prepare to execute Malak Dross, a well-known local Infractionist, for refusing to give up the location of the missing Tech-Priest. He professes not to know what they are talking about. Arguing for Dross’s life requires a Challenging (+0) Rapport (Charm) or Logic (Investigation) Test, with success granting the characters a new Infractionist @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.qxkAEAcB9xAl56Xa#personal-influence]{Contact}. Dross knows nothing about the missing Tech-Priest, but is a valuable guide to the Lower Hive hab slums.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.pQYkca5.description: A few inebriated @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourers} have gathered outside an illicit bar, heedless of the Skitarii's presence. They demand a few solars each from the characters, but back down if a character passes a Challenging (+0) Presence (Intimidation) or Rapport (Charm) Test.

!tables.results!yxEXWbQdSsRMtDcS.xU8sEnO.description: A successful Routine (+20) Intuition (Surroundings) or Awareness (Sight) Test reveals that the street ahead, curiously free of citizens but marked by recent blood stains, is being watched by a @UUID[Actor.jSJkugzVGrfqbl9o]{Skitarii Vanguard} from on high. The characters can pass safely by making a Challenging (+0) Stealth (Move Silently) Test. Failing this Test or the previous ones, the Vanguard calls in a patrol to investigate and follow the characters.
